```abap
FORM vim_process_assigns.
  DATA: length TYPE i, keydate_alr_assigned(1) TYPE c,
        tablength TYPE i, texttablength TYPE i, keylen_bef_date TYPE i,
        xlength type i.

  TRANSLATE vim_prtfky_assigned USING 'XY'.
  ASSIGN: <initial> TO <initial_x> CASTING,
          total TO <vim_ctotal> CASTING TYPE c,
          total TO <vim_total_struc> CASTING TYPE (x_header-maintview),
          total to <vim_xtotal> casting,
          extract TO <vim_cextract> CASTING TYPE c,
          extract TO <vim_extract_struc>
           CASTING TYPE (x_header-maintview),
          extract to <vim_xextract> casting,
          corr_keytab-tabkey to <vim_corr_keyx> casting.
  tablength = x_header-after_tabc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.
  texttablength =
   x_header-aft_txttbc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.

  IF x_header-bastab NE space AND x_header-texttbexst NE space.
    length = tablength + texttablength.
    xlength = x_header-texttablen + x_header-tablen.
    ASSIGN: <vim_ctotal>+tablength(texttablength) TO <total_text>,
            <vim_xtotal>+x_header-after_tabc(x_header-texttablen)
             to <vim_xtotal_text>,
            <vim_xtotal_text> to <vim_tot_txt_struc>
             casting type (x_header-texttab),
            <vim_cextract>(tablength) TO <extract_enti>,
            <vim_cextract>+tablength(texttablength) TO <extract_text>,
            <vim_xextract>+x_header-after_tabc(x_header-texttablen)
             to <vim_xextract_text>,
            <vim_xextract_text> to <vim_ext_txt_struc>
             casting type (x_header-texttab).
ELSE.
    length = tablength.
    xlength = x_header-tablen.
  ENDIF.
  ASSIGN: <vim_ctotal>+length(1) TO <action>,
          <action>+1(1) TO <mark>,
          <vim_cextract>(length) TO <table2>,
          <vim_xextract>(xlength) to <table2_x>,
          <vim_xextract>(x_header-tablen) to <vim_xextract_enti>,
          <vim_cextract>+length(1) TO <xact>,
          <xact>+1(1)  TO <xmark>,
          <vim_ctotal>(vim_ctabkeylen) TO <vim_total_key>,
          <vim_cextract>(vim_ctabkeylen) TO <vim_extract_key>,
          <vim_xtotal>(x_header-keylen) TO <vim_xtotal_key>,
          <vim_xextract>(x_header-keylen) TO <vim_xextract_key>.

  IF x_header-bastab NE space AND x_header-texttbexst NE space.
    ASSIGN: <mark>+1(1) TO <action_text>,
            <xmark>+1(1) TO <xact_text>.
  ENDIF.
  IF x_header-adrnbrflag NE space.
    assign vim_addresses_to_save-handle to <vim_addr_handle_x> casting.
    LOOP AT x_namtab WHERE domname IN adrnbr_domain.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT x_namtab-viewfield OF STRUCTURE
       <vim_total_struc> TO <vim_total_address_number>.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
  IF x_header-delmdtflag NE space.
    LOOP AT x_namtab WHERE domname EQ vim_delim_date_domain
                       AND ( rollname in vim_begda_types or
                             rollname in vim_endda_types ).
      IF x_namtab-rollname in vim_begda_types.
* begin date
        IF x_header-delmdtflag EQ 'E'.
* end date is key field
          IF x_namtab-texttabfld EQ space.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT x_namtab-viewfield OF STRUCTURE
             <vim_total_struc> TO <vim_begdate>.
*            ASSIGN total+x_namtab-position(x_namtab-flength)
*                                   TO <vim_begdate> TYPE 'D'.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.                          "begin date is key field
          CHECK keydate_alr_assigned EQ space OR

                x_namtab-texttabfld NE space OR
                keydate_alr_assigned EQ 'T' AND
                x_namtab-texttabfld EQ space.
          IF x_namtab-texttabfld EQ space.
            TRANSLATE keydate_alr_assigned USING ' ETX'.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT x_namtab-viewfield OF STRUCTURE

* for downward compatibility only:

            ELSE.

                                                              casting ,

          ENDIF.
```

  "source": [
    "FUNCTION trint_objects_check_and_insert.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_ORDER) TYPE  TRKORR DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_WITH_DIALOG) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_SEND_MESSAGE) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_NO_SHOW_OPTION) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_NO_STANDARD_EDITOR) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_EXTERNALPS) TYPE  TR_EXTPS DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_EXTERNALID) TYPE  TR_EXTPID DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_NO_PS) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_READ_ACTIVITY_FROM_MEMORY) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_APPEND_TO_ORDER) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_INSERT_INTO_SBCSETS) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT 'X'",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_OLD_CALL) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN DEFAULT SPACE",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IS_API_CALL) TYPE  SCTSA_S_API_CALL OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(IT_OBJ_ENTRIES) TYPE  CTS_OBJ_ENTRIES OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_ORDER) TYPE  TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_TASK) TYPE  TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_OBJECTS_APPENDABLE) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_OBJECT_UNLOCKED) TYPE  TRBOOLEAN",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ES_RESULT) TYPE  SCTSA_S_RESULT",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ET_TADIR) TYPE  SCTS_TADIR",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ET_OBJPROPS) TYPE  SCTSA_T_OBJECT_PROPS",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CT_KO200) TYPE  TREDT_OBJECTS OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CT_E071K) TYPE  TREDT_KEYS OPTIONAL",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(CT_E071K_STR) TYPE  E071K_STRTYP OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_APPEND_ERROR_KEYS",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_APPEND_ERROR_OBJCT",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_APPEND_ERROR_ORDER",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_BUT_SE01",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_NO_HEADER_OBJECT",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_NO_ORDER_SELECTED",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_REPAIRED_OBJECT",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_SYSTEM_ERROR",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_TADIR_MISSING",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_TADIR_UPDATE_ERROR",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_UNKNOWN_DEVCLASS",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_UNKNOWN_OBJECTTYPE",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_CLOSED_SYSTEM",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_CONSOLIDATION_LEVEL",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_DDIC_IN_CUSTOMER_SYS",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_DELIVERY_SYSTEM",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_DIFFERENT_ORDERTYPES",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_DIFFERENT_TASKTYPES",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_ENQUEUE_FAILED",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_GENERATED_OBJECT",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_ILL_LOCK",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_LOCK_ENQUEUE_FAILED",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_MIXED_ORDERS",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_MIX_LOCAL_TRANSP_OBJ",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_NO_SHARED_REPAIR",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_OBJECT_LOCKED",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_REPAIRED_OBJECT",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_SHOW_CLIENT",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_TADIR_MISSING",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_UNKNOWN_DEVCLASS",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_NO_CHECK_CALL",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_CATEGORY_MIXTURE",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_CLOSED_CLIENT",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_CLOSED_ALE_OBJECT",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_UNALLOWED_SUPERUSER",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_CUSTOM_OBJ_AT_SAP",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_ACCESS_DENIED",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_NO_REPAIR_SYSTEM",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_NO_LICENSE",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_CENTRAL_BASIS",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_USER_AFTER_ERROR",
    "*\"      CANCEL_EDIT_USER_AFTER_ERROR",
    "*\"      SHOW_ONLY_OBJECT_NOT_PATCHABLE",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*!!! Any changes to the interface of this function module (including optional",
    "*    parameters and exceptions) have to be copied to module SCPR_SWITCH_OBJECTS_INSERT.",
    "*    The interfaces of both modules must match. Moreover, the parameters and",
    "*    exceptions have to be passed:",
    "*",
    "*    TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT (IV_INSERT_INTO_SBCSETS = 'X')",
    "*      |",
    "*      :->-",
    "*      :   | call and pass parameters",
    "*      :   V",
    "*      : SCPR_SWITCH_OBJECTS_INSERT",
    "*      :   |",
    "*      :   :->-",
    "*      :   :   | call and pass parameters",
    "*      :   :   V",
    "*      :   : TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT (IV_INSERT_INTO_SBCSETS = ' ')",
    "*      :   :   |",
    "*      :   :-<-",
    "*      :   |",
    "*      :   if sy-subrc <> 0 raise corresponding exception.",
    "*      :   |",
    "*      :-<-",
    "*      |",
    "*      if sy-subrc <> 0 raise corresponding exception.",
    "*",
    "* The only exceptions from this rule are:",
    "*",
    "*     - the parameter IV_INSERT_INTO_SBCSETS which",
    "*       is used to distinguish the outer from the inner call of",
    "*       TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT.",
    "*     - the parameters for remote WBO API invocation, which is currently not used",
    "*       in the context of switch BC sets:",
    "*         IS_API_CALL",
    "*         ES_RESULT",
    "*         ET_OBJPROPS",
    "",
    "* control panels for managing flags and attributes",
    "  DATA: ls_g TYPE gty_global_panel,  \" object independent flags and attributes",
    "        ls_s TYPE gty_single_panel,  \" flags and attributes of one object; initialized at begin of loops; valid only within loops",
    "        ls_m TYPE gty_multi_panel.   \" flags and attributes cumulated for all objects",
    "",
    "* Variables with only temporary validity.",
    "* Never use these variables to transfer data between different control blocks.",
    "  DATA: lv_rcode                TYPE sysubrc,       \" temporarily store sy-subrc",
    "        lv_index                TYPE sytabix,       \" temporarily store sy-tabix",
    "        lv_answer               TYPE c LENGTH 1,    \" answer from POPUP_TO_CONFIRM*",
    "        lv_uname                TYPE syuname,       \" user name in messages",
    "        lv_lines                TYPE sytabix,       \" count lines of internal tables",
    "        lv_tresn_gen_res_w      TYPE trboolean,     \" result from TRESN check on warning messages",
    "        lv_tresn_check_ok       TYPE trboolean,     \" result from TRESN check",
    "        lv_use_memory           TYPE trboolean,     \" tell TRINT_DEVCLASS_GET to use its memory",
    "        lv_found                TYPE trboolean,     \" flag indicating something exists",
    "        lv_not_found            TYPE trboolean,     \" flag indicating something is missing",
    "        lv_inconsistent_task    TYPE trboolean,     \" flag indicating a task assigned to a non-existent request",
    "        lv_no_dialog            TYPE as4flag,       \" dialog mode for TRINT_ORDER_CHOICE",
    "        lv_rep_set              TYPE trboolean,     \" set repair flag in TR_TADIR_INTERFACE",
    "        lv_rep_remv             TYPE trboolean,     \" remove repair flag in TR_TADIR_INTERFACE",
    "        lv_gen_set              TYPE trboolean,     \" set generation flag in TR_TADIR_INTERFACE",
    "        lv_gen_remv             TYPE trboolean,     \" remove generation flag in TR_TADIR_INTERFACE",
    "        lv_trkorr               TYPE trkorr,        \" request/task id",
    "        lv_activity             TYPE tractivity,    \" IMG activity",
    "        lv_objecttype           TYPE ob_typ,        \" SOBJ object type",
    "        lv_objectname           TYPE ob_object,     \" SOBJ object name",
    "        lv_request_owner_text   TYPE symsgv,        \" textual representation of a request and its owner",
    "        lv_task_owner_text      TYPE symsgv,        \" textual representation of a task and its owner",
    "        lv_append_no            TYPE trkorr,        \" request/task used for physical append of objects",
    "        ls_e071                 TYPE e071,          \" structure e071",
    "        lr_e071                 TYPE REF TO e071,   \" reference on structure e071",
    "        ls_ko200                TYPE ko200,         \" structure ko200",
    "        ls_e071k                TYPE e071k,         \" structure e071k",
    "        ls_e071k_str            TYPE e071k_str,     \" structure e071k_str",
    "        lr_tadir                TYPE REF TO tadir,  \" reference on structure tadir",
    "        ls_enqueue              TYPE rse_tlock,     \" structure for enqueued TADIR/TLOCK object",
    "        ls_order_header         TYPE trwbo_request_header,\" structure for request header",
    "        ls_task_header          TYPE trwbo_request_header,\" structure for task header",
    "        ls_tadirkey             TYPE adir_key,      \" structure for TADIR key",
    "        lr_namespace            TYPE REF TO trnsp_namespace,\" reference on structure for namespace",
    "        lr_dlvunit              TYPE REF TO trdlvunit, \" reference on structure for software component",
    "        ls_tdevc_for_order_type TYPE tdevc,         \" structure for package",
    "        ls_cico_lock            TYPE tlockcio,      \" structure for locks on externally edited objects",
    "        ls_msg                  TYPE gty_message,   \" structure for T100 message (internal type with short field names)",
    "        ls_symsg                TYPE trsymsg,       \" structure for T100 message",
    "        ls_coll_err             TYPE ty_err,        \" object dependent I-message",
    "        lr_coll_err             TYPE REF TO ty_err, \" reference on object dependent I-message",
    "        lr_coll_err_cond        TYPE REF TO ty_err_cond, \" reference on object independent I-message",
    "        ls_request_header       TYPE trwbo_request_header,\" structure for request header",
    "        ls_trpar_int            TYPE trpar_int,     \" structure for type check results",
    "        lt_requests             TYPE trwbo_requests,\" table of selected requests",
    "        lr_request              TYPE REF TO trwbo_request,\" reference on entry of table of selected requests",
    "        lv_text(100)            TYPE c.             \" text variable for popup",
    "",
    "* Variables for special purposes",
    "* Reference on current entry of table ct_ko200",
    "  DATA: lr_ko200                TYPE REF TO ko200.  \" reference on current entry of table ct_ko200",
    "",
    "* Variables for remote WBO API invocation",
    "  DATA: ls_objprops             TYPE sctsa_s_object_props,     \" properties of an object",
    "        lr_objprops             TYPE REF TO sctsa_s_object_props. \" reference on properties of an object",
    "",
    "* Storage of object attributes in memory (for verification of correct invocation sequence)",
    "  DATA: ls_memo                 TYPE gty_memory_object,        \" properties of one object",
    "        lt_memo                 TYPE gty_memory_objects,       \" properties of all objects",
    "        lr_memo                 TYPE REF TO gty_memory_object. \" reference on entry of property table",
    "",
    "* Table of enqueued TADIR/TLOCK objects",
    "  DATA: lt_enqueue              TYPE rse_tlocks.    \" table of enqueued TADIR/TLOCK objects",
    "",
    "* Lock analysis",
    "  DATA: ls_tlock                TYPE tlock,         \" highest found lock entry",
    "        lt_all_locks            TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tlock, \" table of all found lock entries",
    "        lr_tlock                TYPE REF TO tlock,  \" reference on entry of lock table",
    "        ls_e070                 TYPE e070,          \" found task holding a lock",
    "        ls_e070_tr              TYPE e070.          \" found request holding a lock or containing a task holding a lock",
    "",
    "* Object catalog entries for invocation of TRINT_TADIR_INTERFACE",
    "  DATA: ls_extended_tadir       TYPE gty_extended_tadir,                   \" extended object catalog entry",
    "        lt_extended_tadir       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gty_extended_tadir, \" table of extended object catalog entries",
    "        lr_extended_tadir       TYPE REF TO gty_extended_tadir.            \" reference on entry of object catalog table",
    "",
    "* Object tables for invocation of TRINT_APPEND_TO_COMM_ARRAYS and other function modules",
    "  DATA: lt_e071                 TYPE tr_objects,                 \" table of entries to be recorded",
    "        lt_e071_task            TYPE tr_objects,                 \" table of entries to be recorded in a correction or customizing task",
    "        lt_e071_repair          TYPE tr_objects,                 \" table of entries to be recorded in a repair task",
    "        lt_e071_custsyn         TYPE tr_objects,                 \" copy of table of entries to be recorded for customizing synchronizer",
    "        lt_trpar_int            TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF trpar_int,\" table of type check results",
    "        lt_trpar_int_task       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF trpar_int,\" table of type check results (correction/customizing Task)",
    "        lt_trpar_int_repair     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF trpar_int,\" table of type check results (repair task)",
    "        lt_tlock_key            TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tlock_int,\" table of lock keys",
    "        lt_tlock_key_task       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tlock_int,\" table of lock keys (correction/customizing Task)",
    "        lt_tlock_key_repair     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF tlock_int.\" table of lock keys (repair task)",
    "",
    "* Tables for namespaces and software components installed in the system",
    "  DATA: lt_namespace            TYPE trnsp_namespaces, \" table of installed namespaces",
    "        lt_dlvunits             TYPE trdlvunits.       \" table of installed software components",
    "",
    "* Collect objects to be marked as repaired",
    "  DATA: ls_rep_popup            TYPE adir_key,                   \" key of an object to be marked as repaired",
    "        lt_rep_popup            TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF adir_key. \" keys of all objects to be marked as repaired",
    "",
    "* Collect I-messages to be sent only once",
    "  DATA: lt_coll_err             TYPE ty_errs,       \" object dependent I-messages",
    "        lt_coll_err_cond        TYPE ty_errs_cond.  \" object independent I-messages",
    "",
    "* Conversion of CTS_OBJ_ENTRIES in E071/E071K(_STR)",
    "  DATA: lv_result               TYPE CTS_RESULT,",
    "        lt_messages             TYPE CTS_MESSAGES,",
    "        ls_message              TYPE CTS_MESSAGE,",
    "        lv_msgno                TYPE symsgno,",
    "        ls_var1                 TYPE CTS_VARIABLE,",
    "        ls_var2                 TYPE CTS_VARIABLE,",
    "        ls_var3                 TYPE CTS_VARIABLE,",
    "        ls_var4                 TYPE CTS_VARIABLE.",
    "",
    "*** initialization *****************************************************",
    "  CLEAR: ev_order,",
    "         ev_task,",
    "         ev_objects_appendable,",
    "         ev_object_unlocked,",
    "         es_result,",
    "         et_tadir,",
    "         et_objprops.",
    "  es_result-result = sctsa_result_ok.",
    "",
    "*** convert CTS_OBJ_ENTRIES into KO200/E071 and E071K(_STR) tables",
    "  IF it_obj_entries IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "    IF ct_ko200 IS NOT INITIAL OR ct_e071k IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "      PERFORM raise_error_no_show",
    "        USING lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "              0",
    "              'TK' 244 '' '' '' ''",
    "              iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "              is_api_call",
    "              gc_raise2_append_error_keys",
    "       CHANGING es_result.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CONVERT_OBJ_ENTRIES'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        it_obj_entries       = it_obj_entries",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        ev_result            = lv_result",
    "        et_messages          = lt_messages",
    "        et_ko200             = ct_ko200",
    "        et_e071k             = ct_e071k",
    "        et_e071k_str         = ct_e071k_str.",
    "",
    "    IF lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.",
    "* update es_result and return in case of remote WBO API invocation",
    "      IF is_api_call-is_api = 'X'.",
    "        es_result-result = lv_result.",
    "        APPEND LINES OF lt_messages TO es_result-messages.",
    "        PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        READ TABLE lt_messages INDEX 1 INTO ls_message.",
    "        READ TABLE ls_message-variables INDEX 1 INTO ls_var1.",
    "        READ TABLE ls_message-variables INDEX 2 INTO ls_var2.",
    "        READ TABLE ls_message-variables INDEX 3 INTO ls_var3.",
    "        READ TABLE ls_message-variables INDEX 4 INTO ls_var4.",
    "        lv_msgno = ls_message-msgnr.",
    "        PERFORM raise_error_no_show",
    "          USING lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                0",
    "                ls_message-arbgb lv_msgno ls_var1-variable",
    "                ls_var2-variable ls_var3-variable ls_var4-variable",
    "                iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                is_api_call",
    "                gc_raise2_append_error_keys",
    "          CHANGING es_result.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* Initialize table et_objprops",
    "* Do this always since it might be useful info in all invocation cases.",
    "* Use initial keys from ct_ko200, since table ct_ko200 is modified later.",
    "* Use table index as link between et_objprops and ct_ko200",
    "  CLEAR ls_objprops.",
    "  LOOP AT ct_ko200 REFERENCE INTO lr_ko200.",
    "    MOVE-CORRESPONDING lr_ko200->* TO ls_objprops-key.",
    "    APPEND ls_objprops TO et_objprops.",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "",
    "* CWB call: Transport interface was called by tx SCWB",
    "  IF cl_cwb_runtime=>is_active EQ 'X'.",
    "    ls_g-cwb_is_active = 'X'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    ls_g-cwb_is_active = ' '.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "***SFW:",
    "  ls_m-lockable_only  = 'X'.",
    "  ls_m-cli_dep_only = 'X'.",
    "  ls_m-call_scpr_transport    = ' '.",
    "",
    "* Remote WBO API call: Assert correct settings for this internal invocation mode",
    "  IF is_api_call-is_api = 'X'.",
    "    IF is_api_call-is_check = 'X'.",
    "      ASSERT is_api_call-is_insert = space.",
    "      ASSERT iv_with_dialog = space.",
    "      ASSERT is_api_call-request = space.",
    "      ASSERT is_api_call-new_request = space.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      ASSERT is_api_call-is_check = space.",
    "      ASSERT is_api_call-is_insert = 'X'.",
    "      ASSERT iv_with_dialog = 'D'.",
    "      IF is_api_call-request <> space.",
    "        ASSERT is_api_call-new_request = space.",
    "*     ELSE.",
    "* Different cases possible in A1S fine tuning scenario. Will be checked later.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    ASSERT iv_order = space.",
    "    ASSERT iv_send_message = space.",
    "    ASSERT iv_no_show_option = space.",
    "    ASSERT iv_no_standard_editor = space.",
    "    ASSERT iv_externalps = space.",
    "    ASSERT iv_externalid = space.",
    "* Currently no support for remote WBO API usage in project context.",
    "* May be changed in future.",
    "    ASSERT iv_no_ps = 'X'.",
    "* Currently no reasonable use case for providing IMG activity via memory,",
    "* but anyway it is uncritical to check the memory",
    "    ASSERT iv_read_activity_from_memory = 'X'.",
    "    ASSERT iv_append_to_order = space.",
    "    ASSERT iv_insert_into_sbcsets = space.",
    "    ASSERT iv_old_call = space.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "***matching control parameters",
    "  IF iv_append_to_order <> space.",
    "    ls_m-recording-use_foreign_request = 'X'.          \"this is for TOC",
    "    ls_g-append_to_request_with_lock = 'X'.",
    "    ls_g-append_to_foreign_request = 'X'.  \"this is for TACA",
    "    iv_with_dialog = 'D'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  IF iv_with_dialog = 'C'.",
    "    iv_with_dialog = space.              \"this is for check_cico_locks",
    "    ls_g-checkin_external   = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF   iv_with_dialog      CA   ' D'.",
    "    ls_g-dialog = ' '.",
    "    ls_g-suppress_dialog = 'X'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    ls_g-dialog = 'X'.",
    "    ls_g-suppress_dialog = ' '.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "**first checks on input",
    "  IF is_api_call-is_api = space.",
    "    PERFORM check_input USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                               ct_e071k_str",
    "                               iv_with_dialog",
    "                               iv_send_message iv_no_show_option",
    "                               iv_order",
    "                               iv_append_to_order.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    PERFORM check_api_call_params",
    "      USING    is_api_call",
    "               ls_m",
    "      CHANGING ls_g",
    "               es_result.",
    "    IF es_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.",
    "*   Return error",
    "      PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* In case of remote WBO API invocations no memory operations",
    "  IF is_api_call-is_api = space.",
    "*** read result table from memory (saved in check call) ****************",
    "    IMPORT lt_memo     FROM MEMORY ID 'RESUL1'.",
    "    IF   sy-subrc       <>   0.",
    "      CLEAR lt_memo.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "****read information about sent i-messages    *************************",
    "    IMPORT lt_coll_err FROM MEMORY ID 'ECERR'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** fill global system parameter fields ********************************",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_DDIC'",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      ev_masterflag = ls_g-masterflag. \" = 'X' for user DDIC",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_SYS_PARAMS'",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      systemname         = system_name",
    "      systemtype         = system_type",
    "      systemedit         = system_edit",
    "      system_client_edit = system_client_edit",
    "      sys_cliinddep_edit = system_cliindep_edit",
    "      system_client_role = system_client_role",
    "      ev_sfw_bcset_rec   = ls_g-sfw_bcset_rec",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      OTHERS             = 1.",
    "  IF   sy-subrc  <>   0.",
    "    PERFORM  raise_error_no_show",
    "             USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                    0 sy-msgid sy-msgno",
    "                    sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                    iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                    is_api_call",
    "                    gc_raise2_system_error",
    "             CHANGING es_result.",
    "*   Can only be reached in case of remote WBO API invocation:",
    "*   Return error",

    "************************************************************************",
    "*** begin loop over all objects: object-class/TADIR/locks/more checks **",
    "************************************************************************",
    "  LOOP AT ct_ko200 REFERENCE INTO lr_ko200.",
    "",
    "* initialiaze panel of object specific flags and attributes",
    "    CLEAR: ls_s.",
    "",
    "    ls_s-e071_tabix  =    sy-tabix.",
    "***for combined e071-obj_name check if position of parts ar correct*****",
    "",
    "* Change of obj_name accordingly to rules of long combined names is reflected in",
    "* in table ct_ko200.",
    "* This behavior was valid in TR_EDIT_CHECK_OBJECTS_KEYS in the past, too, but",
    "* was changed with B20K8A1IJV in a strange way, which might lead to buggy",
    "* behavior in case, the caller does not use the modified table from check invocation,",
    "* but a copy of the original table for insert invocation.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CHECK_COMB_E071_OBJ_NAME'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        iv_pgmid    = lr_ko200->pgmid",
    "        iv_object   = lr_ko200->object",
    "        iv_obj_name = lr_ko200->obj_name",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        ev_obj_name = lr_ko200->obj_name.",
    "",
    "*** read object qualifications, add to result table if necessary (TADIR-lockrange) ****",
    "    LOOP AT lt_memo REFERENCE INTO lr_memo",
    "      WHERE  e071_pgmid    =  lr_ko200->pgmid",
    "      AND    e071_object   =  lr_ko200->object",
    "      AND    e071_obj_name =  lr_ko200->obj_name",
    "      AND    e071_gennum   =  lr_ko200->gennum \" language",
    "      AND    e071_objfunc  =  lr_ko200->objfunc.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0. \" check object and store result in lt_memo",
    "",
    "      IF   iv_with_dialog =    k_x",
    "      AND  iv_old_call    =    space",
    "      AND  is_api_call-is_api = space. \" check before insert not required for API call",
    "        PERFORM  raise_error_no_show",
    "                 USING    lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                          ls_s-e071_tabix 'TK' 425 ' ' ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "                          iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                          is_api_call",
    "                          gc_raise2_no_check_call",
    "                 CHANGING es_result.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "      CLEAR: ls_e071, ls_memo.",
    "      ls_e071-pgmid       =    lr_ko200->pgmid.",
    "      ls_e071-object      =    lr_ko200->object.",
    "      ls_e071-obj_name    =    lr_ko200->obj_name.",
    "      ls_e071-objfunc     =    lr_ko200->objfunc.",
    "      ls_e071-gennum      =    lr_ko200->gennum.",
    "",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_CHECK_TYPE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          wi_e071                        = ls_e071",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          pe_name_too_long               = ls_memo-name_too_long",
    "          pe_result                      = ls_memo-check_result",
    "          we_e071                        = ls_e071     \" copied later",
    "          we_lock_key                    = ls_s-lock_key \" copied later",
    "          we_tadir                       = ls_s-tadir    \" copied later",
    "          we_complete_only               = ls_memo-complete_only",
    "          we_category                    = ls_memo-category",
    "          we_cli_dep                     = ls_memo-cli_dep",
    "          we_table_typ                   = ls_memo-table_type",
    "          we_table_contflag              = ls_memo-table_contflag",
    "          ev_no_object_name              = ls_memo-no_object_name",
    "          ev_name_too_long_for_old       = ls_memo-name_too_long_for_old",
    "          ev_name_with_nonstandard_chars = ls_memo-nonstandard_chars",
    "          ev_r3trtext_syntaxerror        = ls_memo-r3trtext_syntaxerror",
    "          ev_langtyp                     = ls_memo-language_dep",
    "          ev_langtypa                    = ls_memo-language_type",
    "          ev_logo_obj                    = ls_memo-logo_object",
    "          ev_curr_setting                = ls_memo-curr_setting",
    "          ev_namespace                   = ls_memo-namespace.",
    "",
    "      ls_memo-e071_pgmid    = lr_ko200->pgmid     = ls_e071-pgmid.",
    "      ls_memo-e071_object   = lr_ko200->object    = ls_e071-object.",
    "      ls_memo-e071_obj_name = lr_ko200->obj_name  = ls_e071-obj_name.",
    "      ls_memo-e071_objfunc  = lr_ko200->objfunc   = ls_e071-objfunc.",
    "      ls_memo-e071_gennum   = lr_ko200->gennum    = ls_e071-gennum.",
    "      ls_memo-pgmid       = ls_s-tadir-pgmid.",
    "      ls_memo-object      = ls_s-tadir-object.",
    "      ls_memo-obj_name    = ls_s-tadir-obj_name.",
    "",
    "      MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_s-lock_key TO ls_memo.",
    "",
    "      APPEND ls_memo TO lt_memo.",
    "      GET REFERENCE OF ls_memo INTO lr_memo.",
    "",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** Does the object list contain any objects that are not lockable?",
    "*** Is one of the objects that are not lockable client independent?",
    "    IF lr_memo->check_result = 'R'.",
    "      CLEAR ls_m-lockable_only.",
    "      IF lr_memo->cli_dep = ' '.",
    "        CLEAR ls_m-cli_dep_only.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "***SFW: Now we can decide whether it will be necessary to call the BC-Set recording at the end.",
    "",
    "  IF ls_m-lockable_only = ' ' AND",
    "     iv_insert_into_sbcsets   = 'X' AND",
    "     iv_with_dialog         = 'X'.",
    "",
    "    IF ls_g-sfw_bcset_rec = 'X'.",
    "      ls_m-call_scpr_transport = 'X'.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "*       Check whether any active switch exists",
    "      IF sy-mandt = '000' OR  \" reference client",
    "         ls_m-cli_dep_only = ' '.",
    "        cl_abap_switch=>get_switches_in_use( IMPORTING p_is_switch_in_use = ls_m-call_scpr_transport ).",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        cl_abap_switch=>get_switches_in_use( EXPORTING p_client = sy-mandt",
    "                                             IMPORTING p_is_switch_in_use = ls_m-call_scpr_transport ).",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "  LOOP AT ct_ko200 REFERENCE INTO lr_ko200.",
    "",
    "* initialiaze panel of object specific flags and attributes",
    "    CLEAR: ls_s.",
    "",
    "    REFRESH: lt_namespace.",
    "",
    "    ls_s-e071_tabix  =    sy-tabix.",
    "",
    "* get reference of corresponding entry of et_objprops",
    "    READ TABLE et_objprops INDEX ls_s-e071_tabix REFERENCE INTO lr_objprops.",
    "    ASSERT sy-subrc = 0.",
    "",
    "*** read object qualifications (TADIR-lockrange) ****",
    "",
    "    LOOP AT lt_memo REFERENCE INTO lr_memo",
    "      WHERE  e071_pgmid    =  lr_ko200->pgmid",
    "      AND    e071_object   =  lr_ko200->object",
    "      AND    e071_obj_name =  lr_ko200->obj_name",
    "      AND    e071_gennum   =  lr_ko200->gennum \" language",
    "      AND    e071_objfunc  =  lr_ko200->objfunc.",
    "      EXIT.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    ASSERT sy-subrc =    0.",
    "",
    "*** Read all information from LT_MEMO, but field EXIT/TADIR-attr *",
    "    ls_s-check_result                     = lr_memo->check_result.",
    "    ls_s-check_error-no_object_name       = lr_memo->no_object_name.",
    "    ls_s-check_error-name_too_long        = lr_memo->name_too_long.",
    "    ls_s-check_error-nonstandard_chars    = lr_memo->nonstandard_chars.",
    "    ls_s-check_error-r3trtext_syntaxerror = lr_memo->r3trtext_syntaxerror.",
    "    ls_s-complete_only                    = lr_memo->complete_only.",
    "    ls_s-category                         = lr_memo->category.",
    "    ls_s-cli_dep                          = lr_memo->cli_dep.",
    "    ls_s-table_type                       = lr_memo->table_type.",
    "    ls_s-table_contflag                   = lr_memo->table_contflag.",
    "    ls_s-language_dep                     = lr_memo->language_dep.",
    "    ls_s-language_type                    = lr_memo->language_type.",
    "    ls_s-logo_object                      = lr_memo->logo_object.",
    "    ls_s-curr_setting                     = lr_memo->curr_setting.",
    "    ls_s-name_too_long_for_old            = lr_memo->name_too_long_for_old.",
    "    ls_s-namespace                        = lr_memo->namespace.",
    "*** unlocked will be new checked ***************************************",
    "    ls_s-tadir-pgmid      =    lr_memo->pgmid.",
    "    ls_s-tadir-object     =    lr_memo->object.",
    "    ls_s-tadir-obj_name   =    lr_memo->obj_name.",
    "    MOVE-CORRESPONDING lr_memo->* TO ls_s-lock_key.",
    "",
    "*** object may be written in lower case ********************************",
    "    CONCATENATE lr_ko200->pgmid lr_ko200->object lr_ko200->obj_name INTO ls_s-obj_text SEPARATED BY space.",
    "    CONCATENATE ls_s-tadir-pgmid ls_s-tadir-object ls_s-tadir-obj_name INTO ls_s-tadir_text",
    "      SEPARATED BY space.",
    "",
    "    APPEND ls_s-tadir TO et_tadir.",

    "*** No check of transport documentation ********************************",
    "    IF   lr_ko200->pgmid       =    'LIMU'",

    "**no cliindep checks for R3TR DSYS NOTE*",

    "                          iv_with_dialog",
    "                          iv_send_message",
    "                          iv_no_show_option",
    "                          is_api_call",
    "                          gc_raise1_mix_local_transp_obj",

    "                       iv_send_message",
    "                       iv_no_show_option",
    "                       is_api_call",
    "                       gc_raise1_closed_system",

    "        PERFORM  raise_error",
    "                 USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",

    "                       sy-mandt ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "                       iv_with_dialog",
    "                       iv_send_message",
    "                       iv_no_show_option",
    "                       is_api_call",
    "                       gc_raise1_closed_client",
    "                 CHANGING es_result.",
    "*   Can only be reached in case of remote WBO API invocation:",

    "      EXPORT lt_memo FROM lt_memo TO MEMORY ID 'RESUL1'.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** If error occured, send error now after export of LT_MEMO",
    "    IF  ls_m-error_tadir-error  =  k_x.",
    "      IF   iv_with_dialog  =  'R'",
    "      AND  ls_m-recording-request         =  space",
    "      AND  ls_m-recording-no_mix_task          =  space.",
    "*** Send S-message, if order will be set dark",
    "        PERFORM send_message_dark_set_on_error  USING",
    "                iv_order 'X' ls_m-category",
    "                ls_m-diag-dark_set_devclass.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "      IF  iv_with_dialog  CA 'R'.",
    "*** Missing TADIR no error, object will be created",
    "        MOVE  ls_m-recording-request  TO  ev_order.",
    "        MOVE  ls_m-recording-no_mix_task   TO  ev_task.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "      ELSEIF iv_with_dialog  =  ' '.",
    "*calls from Mcommeditcheck need exception SHOW_ONLY_TADIR_MISSING   ****",
    "*to continue correctly                                              ****",
    "        PERFORM  raise_error",
    "                 USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                       0",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-id",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-no",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-v1 ls_m-error_tadir-v2",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-v3 ls_m-error_tadir-v4",
    "                       iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                       iv_no_show_option",
    "                       is_api_call",
    "                       gc_raise1_tadir_missing",
    "                 CHANGING es_result.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        PERFORM  raise_error_no_show",
    "                 USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                       0",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-id",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-no",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-v1 ls_m-error_tadir-v2",
    "                       ls_m-error_tadir-v3 ls_m-error_tadir-v4",
    "                       iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                       is_api_call",
    "                       gc_raise2_tadir_missing",
    "                 CHANGING es_result.",
    "*** creation of TADIR failed, so cancel_edit is better, because in most",
    "*** cases there is nothing to show",
    "*                    RAISING CANCEL_EDIT_TADIR_MISSING.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF  ls_m-error_devclass-error  =  k_x.",
    "      PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "",
    "      PERFORM  raise_error",
    "               USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                     0",
    "                     ls_m-error_devclass-id",
    "                     ls_m-error_devclass-no",
    "                     ls_m-error_devclass-v1",
    "                     ls_m-error_devclass-v2",
    "                     ls_m-error_devclass-v3",
    "                     ls_m-error_devclass-v4",
    "                     iv_with_dialog",
    "                     iv_send_message",
    "                     iv_no_show_option",
    "                     is_api_call",
    "                     gc_raise1_unknown_devclass",
    "               CHANGING es_result.",
    "",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** Send info messages of loop, if no error occured",
    "*** first send object independent messages",
    "    LOOP AT lt_coll_err_cond REFERENCE INTO lr_coll_err_cond.",
    "      MESSAGE  ID lr_coll_err_cond->msgid",
    "      TYPE 'I'",
    "      NUMBER  lr_coll_err_cond->msgno.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "",
    "***object dependent messages",
    "    LOOP AT lt_coll_err REFERENCE INTO lr_coll_err .",
    "      IF  lr_coll_err->sent = space.",
    "        MESSAGE  ID  lr_coll_err->msgid",
    "                 TYPE 'I'",
    "                 NUMBER  lr_coll_err->msgno",
    "                 WITH lr_coll_err->pgmid",
    "                      lr_coll_err->object",
    "                      lr_coll_err->obj_name",
    "                      lr_coll_err->devclass.",
    "        lr_coll_err->sent = 'X'.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    EXPORT lt_coll_err FROM lt_coll_err TO MEMORY ID 'ECERR'.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* In case of remote WBO API invocations return in case of any errors",
    "    IF es_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.",
    "      PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.  \" classical invocation/remote WBO API invocation",
    "",
    "",
    "************************************************************************",
    "*** TADIR-checks not source system tadir-repair-popup ******************",
    "************************************************************************",
    "",
    "  IF ls_m-call_scpr_transport = space.",
    "    LOOP AT ct_ko200 REFERENCE INTO lr_ko200.",
    "",
    "* initialiaze panel of object specific flags and attributes",
    "      CLEAR: ls_s.",
    "",
    "      MOVE  sy-tabix  TO  ls_s-e071_tabix.",
    "*** read result table (E071 - checked - tadir - lockrange ) ************",
    "      LOOP AT lt_memo REFERENCE INTO lr_memo",
    "        WHERE  e071_pgmid    =  lr_ko200->pgmid",
    "        AND    e071_object   =  lr_ko200->object",
    "        AND    e071_obj_name =  lr_ko200->obj_name",
    "        AND    e071_gennum   =  lr_ko200->gennum \" language",
    "        AND    e071_objfunc  =  lr_ko200->objfunc.",
    "        EXIT.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      IF   sy-subrc            <>   0.",
    "        PERFORM  raise_error_no_show",
    "                 USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                       0",
    "                       'TK'",
    "                       '118'",
    "                       lr_ko200->pgmid lr_ko200->object",
    "                       lr_ko200->obj_name ' '",
    "                       iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                       is_api_call",
    "                       gc_raise2_system_error",
    "                 CHANGING es_result.",
    "*   Can only be reached in case of remote WBO API invocation:",
    "*   Return error",
    "        PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ELSE.",
    "        ls_s-no_wbo_control   = lr_memo->no_wbo_control.",
    "        ls_s-check_result     = lr_memo->check_result.",
    "        ls_s-cli_dep          = lr_memo->cli_dep.",
    "        ls_s-category         = lr_memo->category.",
    "        ls_s-language_dep     = lr_memo->language_dep.",
    "        ls_s-language_type    = lr_memo->language_type.",
    "        MOVE-CORRESPONDING  lr_memo->* TO ls_s-tadir.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** original in other system, try to repair ** (DDIC-EXIT) ======> *****",
    "      IF   ls_s-check_result     CA   'TL'",
    "      AND  ls_s-no_wbo_control        =    space.",
    "        IF   ls_s-tadir-srcsystem  <>   system_name",
    "        AND ( ls_s-language_dep         <>   'L'",
    "        OR   ls_s-language_type         NA   'EL' )",
    "        AND  ls_s-tadir-srcdep     <>   gc_repaired.",
    "          IF (  iv_with_dialog CA ' R'",
    "            AND is_api_call-is_api = space ).",
    "**** dont send repair-popup in classical check mode ******************************",
    "            ls_s-no_wbo_control = 'X'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "*** object not in sourcesystem, set repairflag *************************",
    "*** import: delete impossible (WI_NO_DELETE_FUNCTION = 'X')*************",
    "*** import: generateflag changable only if tadir not already exists ****",
    "*** import: repairflag changable only if tadir already exists *^********",
    "          IF   ls_g-masterflag  =    space",
    "          AND  iv_with_dialog  CA  'DX'.",
    "*** Set repair flag in insert mode",
    "            LOOP AT lt_rep_popup TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS",
    "              WHERE  pgmid     =  ls_s-tadir-pgmid",
    "              AND    object    =  ls_s-tadir-object",
    "              AND    obj_name  =  ls_s-tadir-obj_name.",
    "              EXIT.",
    "            ENDLOOP.",
    "            IF sy-subrc = 0.",
    "*** Repair flag is set for this TADIR entry already",
    "            ELSE.",
    "              ls_rep_popup-pgmid     =   ls_s-tadir-pgmid.",
    "              ls_rep_popup-object    =   ls_s-tadir-object.",
    "              ls_rep_popup-obj_name  =   ls_s-tadir-obj_name.",
    "              APPEND ls_rep_popup TO lt_rep_popup.",
    "",
    "              lv_gen_set            =  space.",
    "              lv_gen_remv           =  space.",
    "              lv_rep_set            =  k_x.",
    "              lv_rep_remv           =  space.",
    "              ls_s-tadir-srcdep       =  'R'.",
    "*** save all TADIR changes in table lt_extended_tadir ***************************",
    "              READ TABLE lt_extended_tadir REFERENCE INTO lr_extended_tadir",
    "                WITH KEY",
    "                pgmid = ls_s-tadir-pgmid",
    "                object = ls_s-tadir-object",
    "                obj_name = ls_s-tadir-obj_name.",
    "              IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "                CLEAR ls_extended_tadir.",
    "                APPEND ls_extended_tadir TO lt_extended_tadir REFERENCE INTO lr_extended_tadir.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_s-tadir TO lr_extended_tadir->*.",
    "              lr_extended_tadir->rep_set = lv_rep_set.",
    "              lr_extended_tadir->rep_remv = lv_rep_remv.",
    "              lr_extended_tadir->gen_set = lv_gen_set.",
    "              lr_extended_tadir->gen_remv = lv_gen_remv.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "************************************************************************",
    "*** end loop over all objects / prepare database-update              ***",
    "************************************************************************",
    "",
    "",
    "************************************************************************",
    "*** begin database update                                            ***",
    "************************************************************************",
    "* If object existst one can choose only to show the object, when:",
    "*   -on the order request popup  or",
    "*   -on the confirmation popup for creating a new task",
    "",
    "  IF  ls_m-create_objects   <>   'X'",
    "  AND iv_no_show_option   = space.",
    "    ls_m-diag-display_button   =    'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "****up to here there are no locks when ls_m-recording-request is space   **************",
    "  IF ls_m-recording-request = space.",
    "    ls_m-ps-no_request_locks = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "* In case of remote WBO API invocation ommit classical request selection completely",
    "* For a unification of handling of classical/API invocation some general",
    "* refactoring of dialog routines (esp. TRINT_ORDER_CHOICE) is needed.",
    "  IF is_api_call-is_api = space.",
    "    IF  iv_with_dialog  CA ' R'          \"check case",
    "    AND iv_append_to_order = space       \"append to task is wanted",
    "    AND ls_m-ps-no_ps = 'X'                   \"no project system",
    "    AND ls_m-recording-no_mix_task = space",
    "    AND ls_m-recording-request <> space.                \"object is locked",
    "",
    "*** Fill table lt_e071 from ct_ko200",
    "      PERFORM transform_ko200_to_e071",
    "        USING    ct_ko200",
    "        CHANGING lt_e071.",
    "",
    "****check if append to foreign order is possible and wanted ************",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_ORDER_CHOICE'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          wi_simulation          = 'X'",
    "          wi_order_type          = ls_m-request_type",
    "          wi_task_type           = ls_m-no_mix_task_type",
    "          wi_category            = ls_m-category",
    "          wi_client              = sy-mandt",
    "          iv_tarsystem           = ls_m-tarsystem",
    "          wi_order               = ls_m-recording-request",
    "*         WI_E070                = ' '",
    "          wi_suppress_dialog     = 'X'",
    "          wi_cli_dep             = ls_m-cli_dep",
    "          wi_remove_locks        = ' '",
    "          wi_display_button      = ls_m-diag-display_button",
    "          wi_append_to_fo        = ls_m-recording-use_foreign_request",
    "          iv_current_project     = ls_m-ps-project",
    "        IMPORTING",
    "          we_order               = ls_m-recording-request",
    "          we_task                = ls_m-recording-no_mix_task",
    "        TABLES",
    "          wt_e071                = lt_e071",
    "          wt_e071k               = ct_e071k",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          no_correction_selected = 1",
    "          display_mode           = 2",
    "          OTHERS                 = 3.",
    "",
    "      CASE  sy-subrc.",
    "        WHEN  0.",
    "        WHEN  1.",
    "***  Error:  cancel edit choosen from user",
    "          PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "          MESSAGE  ID sy-msgid  TYPE 'E'  NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "                   WITH  sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                   RAISING cancel_edit_user_after_error.",
    "        WHEN  2.",
    "***  Error:  show only choosen from user",
    "          PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "          MESSAGE  ID sy-msgid  TYPE 'E'  NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "                   WITH  sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                   RAISING show_only_user_after_error.",
    "        WHEN  3.",
    "          PERFORM  raise_error_no_show",
    "            USING    lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                     0",
    "                     sy-msgid",
    "                     sy-msgno",
    "                     sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                     iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                     is_api_call",
    "                     gc_raise2_no_order_selected",
    "            CHANGING es_result.",
    "",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "    ENDIF.                               \"end of dialog ' R'",
    "",
    "",
    "* Case Switch-BC-Set recording: do not execute request choice and project lock",
    "* collision checks here. Will be done during inner invocation.",
    "* As a consequence there are no project lock collision checks for customizing",
    "* objects, which are recorded in Switch-BC-Sets only (SAP-internal use-case).",
    "* This is ok. Switch-BC-Set recording role of a client must not be changed anyway.",
    "    IF   ls_m-append_needed   <> space",
    "    AND  ls_g-masterflag          = space",
    "    AND  ls_m-call_scpr_transport = space.",
    "*** if order & task already found, enqueue task when insert mode    ****",
    "      IF   ls_m-recording-no_mix_task    <>   space",
    "      AND  iv_with_dialog CA 'XD'.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'ENQUEUE_E_TRKORR'",
    "          EXPORTING",
    "            trkorr         = ls_m-recording-no_mix_task",
    "          EXCEPTIONS",
    "            foreign_lock   = 1",
    "            system_failure = 2.",
    "        CASE sy-subrc.",
    "          WHEN 1.",
    "            lv_uname  =    sy-msgv1.",
    "            PERFORM  raise_error",
    "                     USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                            ls_m-recording-e071_tabix 'TR' 860",
    "                            ls_m-recording-no_mix_task ls_m-recording-task_obj_text",
    "                            lv_uname ' '",
    "                            iv_with_dialog",
    "                            iv_send_message",
    "                            iv_no_show_option",
    "                            is_api_call",
    "                            gc_raise1_enqueue_failed",
    "                     CHANGING es_result.",
    "",
    "          WHEN 2.",
    "            PERFORM  raise_error",
    "                        USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                              0 sy-msgid sy-msgno",
    "                              sy-msgv1",
    "                              sy-msgv2",
    "                              sy-msgv3",
    "                              sy-msgv4",
    "                              iv_with_dialog",
    "                              iv_send_message",
    "                              iv_no_show_option",
    "                              is_api_call",
    "                              gc_raise1_enqueue_failed",
    "                        CHANGING es_result.",
    "          WHEN OTHERS.",
    "*** enqueue successful, do nothing",
    "        ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "******check known order, or ask for order in dialog********************",
    "***********************************************************************",
    "",
    "***checks on order if known / try to find suggestion for TOC",
    "      PERFORM suggest_order USING lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                                  iv_with_dialog",
    "                                  iv_send_message iv_no_show_option",
    "                                  iv_order",
    "                                  ls_m-ps-no_ps ls_m-ps-project",
    "                                  ls_m-no_mix_task_type ls_m-request_type",
    "                                  ls_m-category ls_m-cli_dep",
    "                                  iv_append_to_order",
    "                                  is_api_call",
    "                         CHANGING ls_m-recording-request ls_m-recording-no_mix_task",
    "                                  ls_m-diag-is_request_set_dark",
    "                                  es_result.",
    "****checks and dialogs with TOC *********************************",
    "      IF iv_with_dialog CA 'XD'          \"insert case",
    "      AND (   (    ls_m-ps-no_ps = space      \"project but no locks",
    "               AND ls_m-ps-no_request_locks = 'X' )",
    "            OR ls_m-ps-no_ps = 'X' ) .        \"no project",
    "*** ask for task and order, order may be filled",
    "        IF   ls_m-recording-no_mix_task         =    space.",
    "          IF   ls_m-recording-request   =    space.",
    "***  Error:  no Dialog allowed and no task found",
    "            IF  iv_with_dialog  =  'D'.",
    "              PERFORM  raise_error_no_show",
    "                       USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                              0 'TK' 599 iv_order ' ' ' ' ' '",
    "                              iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                              is_api_call",
    "                              gc_raise2_no_order_selected",
    "                       CHANGING es_result.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "****                     no dialog is allowed",
    "            IF iv_with_dialog  CA ' D'.",
    "              lv_no_dialog     = 'D'.",
    "            ELSE.",
    "**order is known, thus the only necessary dialog is when creating task",
    "              lv_no_dialog = k_x.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** Fill table lt_e071 from ct_ko200",
    "          PERFORM transform_ko200_to_e071",
    "            USING    ct_ko200",
    "            CHANGING lt_e071.",
    "",
    "***force request popup to be infront of all other guis",
    "***so it will be in front of graph. fullscreen also",
    "          IF lv_no_dialog <> 'D'.",
    "***not necessary for 'D', and it makes problems when called via RFC",
    "            CALL FUNCTION 'SAPGUI_SET_PROPERTY'",
    "              DESTINATION 'SAPGUI'",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                property = 'ACTIVATE'",
    "                value    = 'X'",
    "              EXCEPTIONS",
    "                OTHERS   = 0.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "",
    "",
    "          CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_ORDER_CHOICE'",
    "            EXPORTING",
    "              wi_order_type          = ls_m-request_type",
    "              wi_task_type           = ls_m-no_mix_task_type",
    "              wi_category            = ls_m-category",
    "              wi_client              = sy-mandt",
    "              iv_tarsystem           = ls_m-tarsystem",
    "              wi_order               = ls_m-recording-request",
    "              wi_suppress_dialog     = lv_no_dialog",
    "              wi_cli_dep             = ls_m-cli_dep",
    "              wi_remove_locks        = ' '",
    "              wi_display_button      = ls_m-diag-display_button",
    "              wi_append_to_order     = iv_append_to_order",
    "              wi_append_to_fo        = ls_m-recording-use_foreign_request",
    "              iv_current_project     = ls_m-ps-project",
    "              iv_warn_nostand_tar    = ls_m-diag-point_out_non_default_target",
    "            IMPORTING",
    "              we_order               = ls_m-recording-request",
    "              we_task                = ls_m-recording-no_mix_task",
    "            TABLES",
    "              wt_e071                = lt_e071",
    "              wt_e071k               = ct_e071k",
    "            EXCEPTIONS",
    "              no_correction_selected = 1",
    "              display_mode           = 2",
    "              object_append_error    = 3",
    "              OTHERS                 = 4.",
    "          CASE  sy-subrc.",
    "            WHEN  0.",
    "            WHEN  1.",
    "***  Error:  cancel edit choosen from user",
    "              PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "              MESSAGE  ID sy-msgid  TYPE 'E'  NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "                       WITH  sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                       RAISING cancel_edit_user_after_error.",
    "            WHEN  2.",
    "***  Error:  show only choosen from user",
    "              PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "              MESSAGE  ID sy-msgid  TYPE 'E'  NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "                       WITH  sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                       RAISING show_only_user_after_error.",
    "            WHEN  3.",
    "              IF   lv_no_dialog  <> space.",
    "                IF  iv_with_dialog  CA  ' D'.",
    "***  Error:  dialog not allowed",
    "                  PERFORM  raise_error_no_show",
    "                      USING  lt_enqueue ct_ko200 ct_e071k",
    "                            0",
    "                            sy-msgid",
    "                            sy-msgno",
    "                            sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "                            iv_with_dialog iv_send_message",
    "                            is_api_call",
    "                            gc_raise2_no_order_selected",
    "                      CHANGING es_result.",
    "                ELSE.",
    "",
    "*** Call once more, but now with dialog",
    "                  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_ORDER_CHOICE'",
    "                    EXPORTING",
    "                      wi_order_type          = ls_m-request_type",
    "                      wi_task_type           = ls_m-no_mix_task_type",
    "                      wi_category            = ls_m-category",
    "                      wi_client              = sy-mandt",
    "                      iv_tarsystem           = ls_m-tarsystem",
    "                      wi_order               = ls_m-recording-request",
    "                      wi_suppress_dialog     = ' '",
    "                      wi_cli_dep             = ls_m-cli_dep",
    "                      wi_remove_locks        = ' '",
    "                      wi_display_button      = ls_m-diag-display_button",
    "                      wi_append_to_order     = iv_append_to_order",
    "                      wi_append_to_fo        = ls_m-recording-use_foreign_request",
    "                      iv_current_project     = ls_m-ps-project",
    "                      iv_warn_nostand_tar    = ls_m-diag-point_out_non_default_target",
    "                    IMPORTING",
    "                      we_order               = ls_m-recording-request",
    "                      we_task                = ls_m-recording-no_mix_task",
    "                    TABLES",
    "                      wt_e071                = lt_e071",
    "                      wt_e071k               = ct_e071k",
    "                    EXCEPTIONS",
    "                      no_correction_selected = 1",
    "                      display_mode           = 2",
    "                      object_append_error    = 1",
    "                      OTHERS                 = 3.",
    "                  CASE  sy-subrc.",
    "                    WHEN  1.",
    "                      PERFORM dequeue_all_enqueues USING lt_enqueue.",
    "                      MESSAGE  ID sy-msgid",
    "                               TYPE 'E'",

```abap
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       FORM CHECK_TRANSP_OBJS_FOR_MAINT                              *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  check transport objects for logging during maintenance             *
*---------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_transp_objs_for_maint USING ctofm_return TYPE i.
  DATA: obj_appendable(1) TYPE c, rc LIKE sy-subrc, e071_safe LIKE e071,
      last_order LIKE e071-trkorr, ctofm_ko200_tab LIKE ko200 OCCURS 10,
        ctofm_keytab_safe LIKE corr_keytab OCCURS 50,
        last_corr LIKE e071-trkorr.

  CLEAR ctofm_return.
  CHECK maint_mode EQ aendern.
* Insert IMG-activity
  PERFORM vim_get_img_activity CHANGING e071-activity.  "UF738595/2001
  IF vim_corr_obj_viewname NE x_header-viewname.
    CLEAR e071-trkorr.
    PERFORM get_transp_info.
    CHECK x_header-flag NE vim_transport_denied.
    CHECK vim_actopts-transp_off NE bc_transport_denied.
    IF maint_mode EQ anzeigen. ctofm_return = 4. EXIT. ENDIF.
  ELSE. " csn ext.382209 2002 XB
    IF NOT objh IS INITIAL.
      IF x_header-importable IS INITIAL.
        x_header-importable = objh-importable.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  CHECK vim_client_state EQ vim_log.
  IF <status>-corr_nbr NE <status>-l_corr_nbr.
    CLEAR: <status>-tr_alrchkd, <status>-corr_enqud.
  ENDIF.
  IF <status>-tr_alrchkd NE space.
    vim_corr_obj_viewname = x_header-viewname.
    EXIT.
  ENDIF.
* first get corr nbr for lockable transport objects
  e071_safe = e071.
  CLEAR vim_last_source_system.
  LOOP AT vim_corr_objtab WHERE lockable NE space.
    e071 = vim_corr_objtab.
    PERFORM check_lockable_object USING e071 ctofm_return.
    IF ctofm_return NE 0 OR x_header-flag EQ vim_transport_denied.
      EXIT.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF ctofm_return NE 0 OR x_header-flag EQ vim_transport_denied.
    e071 = e071_safe. EXIT.
  ENDIF.
  vim_corr_obj_viewname = x_header-viewname.
* second: check unlockable objects
* REFRESH VIM_ULO_TRSP_OBJS.
  LOOP AT vim_corr_objtab WHERE lockable EQ space.
    e071 = vim_corr_objtab.
*   APPEND E071 TO VIM_ULO_TRSP_OBJS.
    APPEND e071 TO ctofm_ko200_tab.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF sy-subrc EQ 0.                    "only if unlockable objects exist
* CTOFM_KO200_TAB = VIM_ULO_TRSP_OBJS.
    LOOP AT corr_keytab.                "save keys of other objects
      LOOP AT vim_corr_objtab WHERE lockable EQ space
                                AND object   EQ corr_keytab-mastertype
                                AND obj_name EQ corr_keytab-mastername.
        EXIT.
      ENDLOOP.
      CHECK sy-subrc NE 0.
      APPEND corr_keytab TO ctofm_keytab_safe.
      DELETE corr_keytab.
    ENDLOOP.
```

```abap
    <x_src>       TYPE x,
    <x_dest>      TYPE x,

  DESCRIBE FIELD ft_tabname LENGTH ft_hf IN CHARACTER MODE.
  ft_max_keylength_char = max_enq_arg_length - ft_hf.
  ft_max_keylength_byte =
    ft_max_keylength_char * cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.

  ASSIGN ft_tabkey TO <x_total_key> CASTING.
* offsets and lengths are in bytes; therefore we need a 'container'
* which interprets offsets as bytes and not char like ft_tabkey would do

        TO <x_dest>.

    ELSE.

      ft_hf = keyfields-offset + keyfields-intlen.
      ft_hf1 = ft_hf DIV ft_max_keylength_byte.

              ft_hf1 * ( ft_hf MOD ft_max_keylength_byte ).

                                         viewfields-inttype
                                         viewfields-datatype
                                         viewfields-decimals
                                         viewfields-convexit space.
        IF sellist-converted EQ space.
          ASSIGN sellist-value(viewfields-outputlen) TO <cvalue>.
          PERFORM input_conversion USING space space <cvalue>
                                         viewfields-inttype
                                         viewfields-intlen
                                         viewfields-datatype
                                         viewfields-decimals
                                         viewfields-leng
                                         viewfields-sign 'A'
                                         space space space
                                         sellist-operator
                                         viewfields-lowercase
                                         viewfields-convexit
                                         not_converted.
          IF not_converted EQ 0.
            i_sellist-converted = 'X'. sellist = i_sellist.

        ASSIGN <x_src>(ft_hf) TO <x_src>.  "reduce to the correct length

        " be interpreted as ft_hf characters
        ASSIGN <x_total_key>+keyfields-offset(ft_hf) TO <x_dest>.
        <x_dest> = <x_src>.
      ENDLOOP.                                              "at sellist
```

```abap
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  vim_set_init_from_sellist
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       If sellist defines values unambiguously, set them into initial
*       WA.
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
*      -->P_TABNAME   tabname
*      -->P_NAMTAB[]  nametab info
*      -->P_SELLIST   selection
*      <--P_INIT      initial view-wa
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM vim_set_init_from_sellist USING    p_tabname TYPE tabname
                                        p_namtab LIKE x_namtab[]
                                        p_sellist LIKE dba_sellist[]
                                        p_maintdesc TYPE vfldroflag
                               CHANGING p_init TYPE any.

  DATA: count TYPE i, h_ix TYPE i, rcode TYPE xfeld,                     "#EC NEEDED
        tabfld TYPE tabfield.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <namtab> TYPE vimnamtab, <sel_wa> TYPE vimsellist,
                 <value> TYPE ANY.

  LOOP AT p_namtab ASSIGNING <namtab> WHERE readonly = p_maintdesc.
    CLEAR: rcode, count, h_ix.
    LOOP AT p_sellist ASSIGNING <sel_wa>
     WHERE viewfield EQ <namtab>-viewfield
           AND ( negation EQ space AND operator EQ 'EQ' OR
                 negation EQ 'NOT' AND operator EQ 'NE' )
           AND ( ddic      CO 'XB' OR
                 ddic      CO 'SB' ).
      ADD 1 TO count.
      CHECK <sel_wa>-and_or EQ space OR <sel_wa>-and_or EQ 'AND'.
      rcode = 'X'. h_ix = sy-tabix.
    ENDLOOP.
    IF rcode = space OR count > 1.
      CLEAR: rcode, count.
      LOOP AT p_sellist ASSIGNING <sel_wa>
       WHERE viewfield EQ <namtab>-viewfield
        AND ( negation EQ space AND operator EQ 'EQ' OR
                   negation EQ 'NOT' AND operator EQ 'NE' )
             AND ( ddic EQ 'A' ).
        ADD 1 TO count.
        CHECK <sel_wa>-and_or EQ space OR <sel_wa>-and_or EQ 'AND'.
        rcode = 'X'. h_ix = sy-tabix.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
    IF rcode <> space AND count = 1.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT <namtab>-viewfield OF STRUCTURE p_init TO <value>.
      CHECK sy-subrc = 0.
      tabfld-tabname = p_tabname.
      tabfld-fieldname = tabfld-lfieldname = <namtab>-viewfield.
      CALL FUNCTION 'RS_CONV_EX_2_IN'
        EXPORTING
          input_external  = <sel_wa>-value
          table_field     = tabfld
        IMPORTING
          output_internal = <value>
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS          = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        CLEAR <value>.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDFORM.                    " vim_set_init_from_sellist
```
