  "source": [
    "FUNCTION view_maintenance_low_level.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(FCODE) DEFAULT 'RDED'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_ACTION) DEFAULT 'S'",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD02V-TABNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(RFC_DESTINATION_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  RFCDES-RFCDEST DEFAULT",
    "*\"       ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(CLIENT_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  SY-MANDT DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLEX_SELCONDS_USED) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIENTINDEP) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(OC_INST) TYPE REF TO  CL_VIEWFIELDS_ORG_CRIT OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(LAST_ACT_ENTRY) LIKE  SY-TABIX",
    "*\"     VALUE(UCOMM)",
    "*\"     VALUE(UPDATE_REQUIRED)",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTION_OUT) TYPE  SYCHAR01",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      CORR_KEYTAB STRUCTURE  E071K",
    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      DPL_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      EXCL_CUA_FUNCT STRUCTURE  VIMEXCLFUN",
    "*\"      EXTRACT",
    "*\"      TOTAL",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"      MISSING_CORR_NUMBER",
    "*\"      NO_VALUE_FOR_SUBSET_IDENT",
    "*\"      SAVING_CORRECTION_FAILED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* data declarations                                                    *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  DATA: function_name(35) TYPE c,",
    "        view_fct_pref(35) TYPE c VALUE 'VIEWPROC_',         \"09 Zeichen",
    "        tabl_fct_pref(35) TYPE c VALUE 'TABLEPROC_',        \"10 Zeichen",
    "*     FPOOL LIKE TRDIR-NAME VALUE 'SAPL    ', RC LIKE SY-SUBRC,",
    "        fpool LIKE trdir-name, rc LIKE sy-subrc,",
    "        length LIKE sy-fdpos, calmode_safe(1) TYPE c,",
    "        specmode_safe(1) TYPE c, specfunctions(4) TYPE c,",
    "        calcls_safe TYPE vcl_name,",
    "      read_texttab(1) TYPE c.                                \"SW Textimp",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <function_name>.",
    "",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* build function name form view/table name and related prefix          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  READ TABLE x_header INDEX 1.",
    "  IF x_header-bastab EQ space.",
    "    MOVE: view_fct_pref TO function_name,",
    "          x_header-maintview TO function_name+9.         \".. Subviews",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    MOVE: tabl_fct_pref TO function_name,",
    "          x_header-area TO function_name+10.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF function_name CA forbidden_func_name_chars.",
    "    PERFORM replace_forbidden_chars USING forbidden_func_name_chars",
    "                                          function_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* check if function to call exists in library                          *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  length = STRLEN( function_name ).",
    "  ASSIGN function_name(length) TO <function_name>.",
    "  READ TABLE alr_checked_views WITH KEY = x_header-viewname",
    "                               BINARY SEARCH",
    "                               TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.",
    "  IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tfdir WHERE funcname EQ <function_name>.",
    "    IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "      RAISE function_not_found.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    INSERT x_header-viewname INTO alr_checked_views INDEX sy-tabix.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* initialize RFC-destination for current view/table                    *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  fpool   = x_header-fpoolname.",
    "  vim_default_rfc_dest-viewname = x_header-viewname.",
    "  vim_default_rfc_dest-rfcdest  = rfc_destination_for_upgrade.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_DEFAULT_RFC_DEST' 'C' vim_default_rfc_dest rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* initialize client for upgrade for current view/table                 *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  vim_default_upgr_clnt-viewname = x_header-viewname.",
    "  vim_default_upgr_clnt-client  = client_for_upgrade.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_DEFAULT_UPGR_CLNT' 'C' vim_default_upgr_clnt rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set flag if called by viewcluster maintenance                        *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' calmode_safe rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calcls_safe rc.",
    "  IF called_by_cluster NE calmode_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' called_by_cluster rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF calling_cluster NE calcls_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calling_cluster rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set variables if special functions requested                         *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF fcode = vim_read_text.                               \"SW Textimp ..",
    "    fcode = read.",
    "    IF x_header-texttbexst <> space.",
    "      read_texttab = 'X'.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                  \".. SW Textimp",
    "  IF fcode EQ 'EXED' OR fcode EQ 'COMP'.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' specmode_safe rc.",
    "    CASE fcode.",
    "      WHEN 'EXED'.",
    "        PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                  USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' vim_extedit rc.",
    "      WHEN 'COMP'.",
    "        PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                  USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' vim_direct_upgrade rc.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    specfunctions = fcode. fcode = edit.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* set flag if complex selection conditions in sellist                  *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF complex_selconds_used NE space.",
    "    READ TABLE dba_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND dba_sellist-cond_kind EQ space.",
    "      dba_sellist-cond_kind = 'C'. MODIFY dba_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    READ TABLE dpl_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0 AND dpl_sellist-cond_kind EQ space.",
    "      dpl_sellist-cond_kind = 'C'. MODIFY dpl_sellist INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* forward NO_WARNING... flag                                           *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "     USING 'VIM_NO_WARNING_FOR_CLIINDEP' 'C' no_warning_for_clientindep",
    "           rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_oc IN PROGRAM (fpool) USING oc_inst.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* call requested function                                              *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CALL FUNCTION <function_name>",
    "    EXPORTING",
    "      fcode                     = fcode",
    "      view_action               = view_action",
    "      view_name                 = view_name",
    "      corr_number               = corr_number",
    "    IMPORTING",
    "      last_act_entry            = last_act_entry",
    "      ucomm                     = ucomm",
    "      update_required           = update_required",
    "    TABLES",
    "      corr_keytab               = corr_keytab",
    "      dba_sellist               = dba_sellist",
    "      dpl_sellist               = dpl_sellist",
    "      excl_cua_funct            = excl_cua_funct",
    "      extract                   = extract",
    "      total                     = total",
    "      x_header                  = x_header",
    "      x_namtab                  = x_namtab",
    "    EXCEPTIONS",
    "      missing_corr_number       = 01",
    "      no_value_for_subset_ident = 02",
    "      saving_correction_failed  = 03.",
    "  CASE sy-subrc.",
    "    WHEN 1.",
    "      RAISE missing_corr_number.",
    "    WHEN 2.",
    "      RAISE no_value_for_subset_ident.",
    "    WHEN 3.",
    "      IF vim_import_profile NE space.\"HCG delete for next BC-Set object",
    "        CLEAR: called_by_cluster, calling_cluster.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      RAISE saving_correction_failed.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "",
    "  IF read_texttab = 'X'.                                  \"SW Textimp ..",
    "    CALL FUNCTION <function_name>",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        fcode                     = vim_read_text",
    "        view_action               = view_action",
    "        view_name                 = view_name",
    "        corr_number               = corr_number",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "        last_act_entry            = last_act_entry",
    "        ucomm                     = ucomm",
    "        update_required           = update_required",
    "      TABLES",
    "        corr_keytab               = corr_keytab",
    "        dba_sellist               = dba_sellist",
    "        dpl_sellist               = dpl_sellist",
    "        excl_cua_funct            = excl_cua_funct",
    "        extract                   = extract",
    "        total                     = total",
    "        x_header                  = x_header",
    "        x_namtab                  = x_namtab",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        missing_corr_number       = 01",
    "        no_value_for_subset_ident = 02",
    "        saving_correction_failed  = 03.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        RAISE missing_corr_number.",
    "      WHEN 2.",
    "        RAISE no_value_for_subset_ident.",
    "      WHEN 3.",
    "        RAISE saving_correction_failed.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "  ENDIF.                                                  \".. SW Textimp",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* get new export parameters                                            *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING '<STATUS>-CORR_NBR' 'C' corr_number rc.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "            USING 'MAINT_MODE' 'C' action_out rc.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* reset flag if called by viewcluster maintenance                      *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  IF called_by_cluster NE calmode_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLED_BY_CLUSTER' 'C' calmode_safe rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF calling_cluster NE calcls_safe.",
    "    PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "              USING 'VIM_CALLING_CLUSTER' 'C' calcls_safe rc.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR: called_by_cluster, calling_cluster.",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "* reset variables if special functions requested                       *",
    "*----------------------------------------------------------------------*",
    "  CASE specfunctions.",
    "    WHEN 'EXED'.",
    "      PERFORM vim_set_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool)",
    "                USING 'VIM_SPECIAL_MODE' 'C' specmode_safe rc.",
    "  ENDCASE.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
  "fingerprint": "23d143e38655c05a4b9f683b8945a84044bb92617ce66675fead4fbcddcd771c",
  "interfaceFingerprint": "d7d7728f3a9d34a5296c194b5dc07307164789146d61bb9d2f66f833af9c3d57",
  "sourceFingerprint": "1aeb5c3d4610373e63188749eb9b77604a8fd8028945e5d405327e6f311be0a0"
}

DISCOVERY ONLY - NEVER an existence check: the repository index retains stale entries for deleted objects and this tool keeps listing them (verified: deletes returned absenceVerified=true while three separate objects were still listed, one still listed 40 minutes later). It cannot distinguish a live object from a deleted one, so a hit here does not prove the object exists and a miss does not prove it is gone. To establish existence, read the object itself: get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri for source objects, and the matching read_* tool for DDIC objects (for example read_search_help).

    "FUNCTION view_maintenance_no_dialog.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  DD02V-TABNAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(CORR_NUMBER) LIKE  E070-TRKORR DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IMPORT_MODE) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(IMPORT_SPEC_MODE) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(TOT_NAME) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(EXT_NAME) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(ACTION) TYPE  VIMTY_TCODE DEFAULT 'EDIT'",
    "*\"     VALUE(COMPLEX_SELCONDS_USED) LIKE  TVDIR-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(RFC_DESTINATION_FOR_UPGRADE) LIKE  RFCDES-RFCDEST DEFAULT",
    "*\"       ' '",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(UPDATE_REQUIRED)",
    "*\"     VALUE(RESULTS) LIKE  VIMMODRES STRUCTURE  VIMMODRES",
    "*\"     VALUE(LAST_LOGGED_MESSAGE) TYPE  VIMTY_MESSAGE",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      CORR_KEYTAB STRUCTURE  E071K",
    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      DPL_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST",
    "*\"      EXTRACT",
    "*\"      TOTAL",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB",
    "*\"      IX_TO_MODIFY STRUCTURE  VIMMODIX",
    "*\"      IMPORT_RESULTS TYPE  SLCTR_TABLES_KEYS OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      MISSING_CORR_NUMBER",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "* SW: neuer Wert für VIMMODIX-ACTION -> UPI",
    "*     gleiche Bedeutung wie UPD, jedoch wird Originaleintrag und",
    "*     zu übernehmender Eintrag in Total übergeben (im Import genutzt)",
    "* MF: neuer Wert für VIMMODIX-ACTION -> DEI",
    "*     gleiche Bedeutung wie DEL, jedoch wird Originaleintrag und",
    "*     zu löschender Eintrag in Total übergeben (BCSet-Import)",
    "",
    "  DATA: restore_local_memory(1) TYPE c, h_lg TYPE i,",
    "        texttablength type i,",
    "        name_for_restore LIKE vimdesc-viewname,",
    "        dummytc TYPE vimty_tcode,",
    "        state_name(30) TYPE c VALUE 'STATUS_', nbr_of_del TYPE i,",
    "        fpool_name LIKE trdir-name, i_action(1) TYPE c,                      \"#EC NEEDED",
    "        dummy_tab LIKE vimexclfun OCCURS 1, fb_rc TYPE i,",
    "        mem_id(42) TYPE c, h_status LIKE vimstatus, counter_safe TYPE i,",
    "        udl_trans_patt(6) TYPE c, upd_trans_patt(4) TYPE c,",
    "        del_trans_patt(6) TYPE c, firstline_safe TYPE i,",
    "      delete_flags(3) TYPE c, set_state(1) TYPE c, nextline_safe TYPE i,  \"#EC NEEDED",
    "        calmode_safe(1) TYPE c, vmnd_results LIKE vimmodres,",
    "        looplines_safe LIKE looplines, calcls_safe TYPE vcl_name,",
    "        i_uselcltbl(1) TYPE c, index_safe TYPE i.",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <extract_x> type x, <x_action>, <x_key>, <x_mrk>,",
    "                 <extract_c> type c.",
    "",
    "  calmode_safe = called_by_cluster. calcls_safe = calling_cluster.",
    "  READ TABLE x_header INDEX 1.",
    "  fpool_name   = x_header-fpoolname.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING 'VIM_ACT_DYNP_VIEW' 'C'",
    "                                           name_for_restore h_lg.",
    "  IF name_for_restore NE space AND name_for_restore NE view_name.",
    "    restore_local_memory = 'X'.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'COUNTER' 'I'",
    "                                             counter_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'FIRSTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             firstline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'NEXTLINE' 'I'",
    "                                             nextline_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'LOOPLINES' 'I'",
    "                                             looplines_safe h_lg.",
    "    PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                       USING 'EXIND' 'I'",
    "                                             index_safe h_lg.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  mem_id = sy-uname. mem_id+12(*) = view_name.",
    "  TRANSLATE mem_id USING ' _'.",
    "  EXPORT extract TO MEMORY ID mem_id.",
    "  h_lg = x_header-after_tabc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "  texttablength =",
    "   x_header-aft_txttbc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "*  h_lg = x_header-tablen.",
    "  IF x_header-bastab NE space AND x_header-texttbexst NE space.",
    "    ADD texttablength TO h_lg.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  state_name+7 = x_header-maintview.   \"Subviews",
    "  ASSIGN: extract to <extract_c> casting,",
    "          extract to <extract_x> casting,",
    "          <extract_c>+h_lg(1) TO <x_action>, <x_action>+1(1) TO <x_mrk>,",
    "          <extract_x>(x_header-keylen) TO <x_key>.",
    "  PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                     USING state_name 'VIMSTATUS'",
    "                                           h_status h_lg.",
    "  MOVE: geloescht TO delete_flags, neuer_geloescht TO delete_flags+1,",
    "        update_geloescht TO delete_flags+2.",
    "  IF tot_name NE space AND ext_name NE space.",
    "    i_uselcltbl = 'X'.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF action EQ 'EDIT'.",
    "    MOVE: geloescht TO udl_trans_patt, zurueckholen TO udl_trans_patt+1,",
    "          neuer_geloescht TO udl_trans_patt+2,",
    "          zurueckholen TO udl_trans_patt+3,",
    "          update_geloescht TO udl_trans_patt+4,",
    "          zurueckholen TO udl_trans_patt+5,",
    "          original TO upd_trans_patt, aendern TO upd_trans_patt+1,",
    "          neuer_eintrag TO upd_trans_patt+2,",
    "          aendern TO upd_trans_patt+3,",
    "          original TO del_trans_patt, geloescht TO del_trans_patt+1,",
    "          aendern  TO del_trans_patt+2,",
    "          update_geloescht TO del_trans_patt+3,",
    "          neuer_eintrag TO del_trans_patt+4,",
    "          neuer_geloescht TO del_trans_patt+5.",
    "    REFRESH extract.",
    "    SORT ix_to_modify BY tot_index.",
    "    LOOP AT ix_to_modify WHERE action NE 'TIN' AND action NE 'TEX'.",
    "      SUBTRACT nbr_of_del FROM ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "      READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "      CASE ix_to_modify-action.",
    "        WHEN 'INS'.",
    "          <x_action> = neuer_eintrag.  \"ignore wrong flags of new entry",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "        WHEN 'COP'.",
    "          <x_action> = kopieren.       \"ignore wrong flags of new entry",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          APPEND extract.              \"destination",
    "          READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-org_tot_ix.",
    "          <x_action> = vim_source_entry. \"source",
    "        WHEN 'UPD'.",
    "          TRANSLATE <x_action> USING upd_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'UPI'.                                         \"SW",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          TRANSLATE <x_action> USING upd_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'UDL'.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING udl_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'DEL'.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING del_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'DEI'.                                         \"MF",
    "          DELETE total INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "          ADD 1 TO nbr_of_del.",
    "          TRANSLATE: <x_action> USING del_trans_patt.",
    "        WHEN 'TIN'.",
    "          <x_action> = task_add.",
    "        WHEN 'TEX'.",
    "          <x_action> = task_del.",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "      APPEND extract.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "      IF import_mode EQ space.",
    "        CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_MAINTENANCE_LOW_LEVEL'",
    "             EXPORTING",
    "                  corr_number                 = corr_number",
    "                  fcode                       = 'EXED'",
    "                  view_action                 = 'U'",
    "                  view_name                   = view_name",
    "                  complex_selconds_used       = complex_selconds_used",
    "               rfc_destination_for_upgrade = rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "             IMPORTING",
    "                  update_required             = update_required",
    "             TABLES",
    "                  corr_keytab                 = corr_keytab",
    "                  dba_sellist                 = dba_sellist",
    "                  dpl_sellist                 = dpl_sellist",
    "                  excl_cua_funct              = dummy_tab",
    "                  extract                     = extract",
    "                  total                       = total",
    "                  x_header                    = x_header",
    "                  x_namtab                    = x_namtab",
    "             EXCEPTIONS",
    "                  missing_corr_number         = 1.",
    "        fb_rc = sy-subrc.",
    "        IF fb_rc EQ 0.",
    "          PERFORM vim_get_global_field_value IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                                      USING 'VIM_RESULTS_OF_EXT_MOD'",
    "                                            'VIMMODRES' results h_lg.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ELSE.                            \"import mode activ",
    "        PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                            USING i_uselcltbl",
    "                                    import_mode corr_number 'EXED' 'U'",
    "                                    view_name tot_name ext_name",
    "                                    rfc_destination_for_upgrade",
    "                                    space update_required corr_keytab[]",
    "                                    dba_sellist[] dpl_sellist[]",
    "                                    dummy_tab extract[] total[]",
    "                                    x_header[] x_namtab[] dummytc",
    "                                    sy-tabix results import_results[]",
    "                                    import_spec_mode",
    "                                    complex_selconds_used.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      called_by_cluster = calmode_safe. calling_cluster = calcls_safe.",
    "      REFRESH extract.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSEIF action EQ 'SAVE'.",
    "    PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (fpool_name)",
    "                        USING i_uselcltbl",
    "                                import_mode corr_number 'SAVE' 'U'",
    "                                view_name tot_name ext_name space space",
    "                                update_required corr_keytab[]",
    "                                dba_sellist[] dpl_sellist[] dummy_tab",
    "                                extract[] total[] x_header[] x_namtab[]",
    "                                dummytc sy-tabix results",
    "                                import_results[] import_spec_mode",
    "                                complex_selconds_used.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  LOOP AT ix_to_modify WHERE action EQ 'TIN' OR action EQ 'TEX'.",
    "    READ TABLE total INTO extract INDEX ix_to_modify-tot_index.",
    "    CASE ix_to_modify-action.",
    "      WHEN 'TIN'.",

schema.name: search_abap_objects
schema.description: Search ABAP objects by name pattern. Wildcards: * ?. Custom code: prefix Z* or Y* (Z*ARTICLE*, not *ARTICLE*). Standard SAP: BAPI_*, CL_*, /SAP/*. MANDATORY before code generation: training data outdated - ALWAYS verify objects exist first, read signatures with get_abap_object_lines, then generate. Unverified code WILL fail at runtime. DISCOVERY ONLY - NEVER an existence check: the repository index retains stale entries for deleted objects and this tool keeps listing them (verified: deletes returned absenceVerified=true while three separate objects were still listed, one still listed 40 minutes later). It cannot distinguish a live object from a deleted one, so a hit here does not prove the object exists and a miss does not prove it is gone. To establish existence, read the object itself: get_abap_object_lines or get_abap_object_workspace_uri for source objects, and the matching read_* tool for DDIC objects (for example read_search_help).

schema.name: read_ddic_transparent_table
schema.description: Read one SAP Dictionary transparent table, including keys, delivery class, technical settings, package, concurrency version, and SHA-256 definition fingerprint. If the object has only a non-active version (for example left behind by an interrupted create), that stored version is returned instead with status 'inactive', active false, its own definitionFingerprint and a resumeTool hint, so the pending definition can be inspected rather than merely reported as blocking. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard objects. A read that completes and finds nothing answers with status "not-found", exists false and authoritative true instead of failing, so a missing object is distinguishable from a broken helper; every other failure is still reported as an error.

    "*\"      DBA_SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      DATA",
    "*\"      X_HEADER STRUCTURE  VIMDESC OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      X_NAMTAB STRUCTURE  VIMNAMTAB OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  CHANGING",
    "*\"     REFERENCE(ORG_CRIT_INST) TYPE  VIMTY_OC_TYPE OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      NO_VIEWMAINT_TOOL",
    "*\"      NO_AUTHORITY",
    "*\"      NO_AUTH_FOR_SEL",
    "*\"      DATA_ACCESS_RESTRICTED",
    "*\"      NO_FUNCTIONGROUP",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*      with char data container due to problems of viewmaintenance",
    "*      modifications with hex total[].",
    "************************************************************************",
    "  CONSTANTS: ext_suffix(10) TYPE c VALUE '_EXTRACT[]',",
    "             tot_suffix(8) TYPE c VALUE '_TOTAL[]',",
    "             maxsellines TYPE i VALUE 500.",
    " DATA: icorrkeytab LIKE e071k OCCURS 0, iexfun LIKE vimexclfun OCCURS 0,",
    "                 isellist LIKE vimsellist OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 header LIKE vimdesc OCCURS 1 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 namtab LIKE vimnamtab OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 iex(4096) TYPE c OCCURS 0, x(1) TYPE c VALUE 'X',",
    "             s(1) TYPE c VALUE 'S', rfc_destination LIKE rfcdes-rfcdest,",
    "            dd_selcond_lines LIKE sy-tfill,\"Anzahl Selektionsbed. aus DD",
    "      usr_selcond_lines LIKE sy-tfill, \"Anzahl übergebene Selektionsbed.",
    "               ix031l LIKE x031l OCCURS 0 WITH HEADER LINE,",
    "                 fnam LIKE d021s-fnam, corr_number LIKE e070-trkorr, \"#EC NEEDED",
    "           upd_requ(1) TYPE c, tot_name(40) TYPE c, ext_name(40) TYPE c,",
    "                table_length TYPE i, x_table_length TYPE i, h_ix TYPE i,",
    "          dummytc TYPE vimty_tcode, results LIKE vimmodres, n_ix TYPE i,",
    "                 import_results TYPE slctr_tables_keys.",
    "  DATA: short_sellist LIKE vimsellist OCCURS 10,",
    "        short_sel LIKE vimsellist, selindex TYPE i, selnumber TYPE i,",
    "        selcut TYPE i, selpieces TYPE i, viewlen TYPE i.",
    "",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <field> TYPE ANY.",
    "",
    "  TYPES: scpr_c64(64)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c128(128)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c256(256)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c512(512)   TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c1024(1024) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c2048(2048) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c4096(4096) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c8192(8192) TYPE c,",
    "       scpr_c64s        TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c64,",
    "       scpr_c128s       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c128,",
    "       scpr_c256s       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c256,",
    "       scpr_c512s       TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c512,",
    "       scpr_c1024s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c1024,",
    "       scpr_c2048s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c2048,",
    "       scpr_c4096s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c4096,",
    "       scpr_c8192s      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scpr_c8192.",
    "",
    "  DATA: wa_tot64   TYPE scpr_c64,",
    "        wa_tot128  TYPE scpr_c128,",
    "        wa_tot256  TYPE scpr_c256,",
    "        wa_tot512  TYPE scpr_c512,",
    "        wa_tot1024 TYPE scpr_c1024,",
    "        wa_tot2048 TYPE scpr_c2048,",
    "        wa_tot4096 TYPE scpr_c4096,",
    "        wa_tot8192 TYPE scpr_c8192,",
    "        f_it_tlibg LIKE TABLE OF tlibg WITH HEADER LINE, \"#EC NEEDED",
    "*        f_wa_tlibg TYPE LINE OF f_it_tlibg,",
    "        it_tot64   TYPE scpr_c64s,",
    "        it_tot128  TYPE scpr_c128s,",
    "        it_tot256  TYPE scpr_c256s,",
    "        it_tot512  TYPE scpr_c512s,",
    "        it_tot1024 TYPE scpr_c1024s,",
    "        it_tot2048 TYPE scpr_c2048s,",
    "        it_tot4096 TYPE scpr_c4096s,",
    "        it_tot8192 TYPE scpr_c8192s.",
    "* Datencontainer und Arbeitsbereiche vorbereiten",
    "  FIELD-SYMBOLS: <it_tmp_data>     TYPE STANDARD TABLE,",
    "                 <wa_it_tmp_data>  TYPE ANY,",
    "                 <wax_it_tmp_data> TYPE ANY,",
    "                 <data_wax>        TYPE ANY.",
    "",
    "  IF x_header IS REQUESTED. DESCRIBE TABLE x_header LINES h_ix. ENDIF.",
    "  IF x_namtab IS REQUESTED. DESCRIBE TABLE x_namtab LINES n_ix. ENDIF.",
    "  IF NOT ( x_header IS REQUESTED AND x_namtab IS REQUESTED ) OR",
    "     h_ix EQ 0 OR n_ix EQ 0.",
    "* Get nametab for view/table",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_GET_DDIC_INFO'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        viewname = view_name",
    "      TABLES",
    "        sellist  = isellist",
    "        x_header = header",
    "        x_namtab = namtab",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "        OTHERS   = 1.",
    "    CASE sy-subrc.",
    "      WHEN 0.",
    "      WHEN 1.",
    "        MESSAGE i383 WITH view_name",
    "                RAISING no_viewmaint_tool.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "* check if the function group exist.",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tlibg INTO f_it_tlibg",
    "        WHERE area = header-area.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      MESSAGE e037 WITH header-area",
    "                   RAISING no_functiongroup.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF dba_sellist IS REQUESTED.       \"adjust both sellists",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE isellist LINES dd_selcond_lines.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE dba_sellist LINES usr_selcond_lines.",
    "      IF dd_selcond_lines EQ 0 AND usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "        MOVE x TO header-selection.",
    "        MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "      ELSEIF dd_selcond_lines NE 0 AND usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "        IF header-subsetflag EQ x AND  \"deal with subsets only if this",
    "           without_subset EQ space.    \"is requested",
    "          LOOP AT isellist WHERE ddic EQ s. \"dd subsets already known",
    "            LOOP AT dba_sellist WHERE viewfield EQ isellist-viewfield",
    "                                  AND ( ( negation EQ space AND",
    "                                          operator EQ 'EQ' ) OR",
    "                                        ( negation NE space AND",
    "                                          operator EQ 'NE' ) ).",
    "              MOVE: dba_sellist-value TO isellist-value,",
    "                    isellist-ddic TO dba_sellist-ddic.",
    "              MODIFY dba_sellist.",
    "              SUBTRACT 1 FROM usr_selcond_lines.",
    "            ENDLOOP.",
    "            IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "              IF isellist-value EQ space.",
    "                isellist-initial = 'X'.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "              MODIFY isellist.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        IF usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "          READ TABLE isellist INDEX dd_selcond_lines.",
    "          MOVE 'AND' TO isellist-and_or.",
    "          MODIFY isellist INDEX dd_selcond_lines.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      IF usr_selcond_lines NE 0.",
    "        LOOP AT dba_sellist WHERE ddic EQ space.",
    "          READ TABLE namtab WITH KEY dba_sellist-viewfield. \"#EC WARNOK",
    "          IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "            dba_sellist-tabix = sy-tabix.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          isellist = dba_sellist.",
    "          IF isellist-value EQ space AND",
    "           ( isellist-negation EQ space AND isellist-operator EQ 'EQ' OR",
    "             isellist-negation EQ 'NOT' AND isellist-operator EQ 'NE' ).",
    "            isellist-initial = 'X'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          APPEND isellist.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "* Nametab given from calling program",
    "    namtab[] = x_namtab[].",
    "    header[] = x_header[].",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tlibg INTO f_it_tlibg",
    "        WHERE area = header-area.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "      MESSAGE e383 WITH header-area",
    "                   RAISING no_functiongroup.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF dba_sellist IS REQUESTED.",
    "      isellist[] = dba_sellist[].",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    IF header-after_keyc = 0.",
    "* Called by compare tool by remote. Delivered header-info frozen at",
    "* release 3.1:",
    "* add missing header-information.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-keylen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-after_keyc.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-textkeylen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-aft_txtkc.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-tablen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-after_tabc.",
    "      PERFORM get_aligned_offset_char(saplsvix)",
    "                                     USING header-texttablen",
    "                                     CHANGING header-aft_txttbc.",
    "      MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF with_authority_check NE space.    \"process authority check",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    IF header-newgener EQ space. \"4.5A: support individual auth. check",
    "      CALL FUNCTION 'VIEW_AUTHORITY_CHECK'",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          view_action                    = 'S'    \"check only show auth.",
    "          view_name                      = view_name",
    "          no_warning_for_clientindep     = 'X'     \"no warning requested",
    "        CHANGING",
    "          org_crit_inst                  = org_crit_inst",
    "        EXCEPTIONS",
    "          table_not_found                = 5",
    "          no_authority                   = 8",
    "          no_clientindependent_authority = 9",
    "          no_linedependent_authority     = 10.",
    "      CASE sy-subrc.",
    "        WHEN 0.",
    "         IF org_crit_inst IS REQUESTED AND NOT org_crit_inst IS INITIAL",
    "                AND check_linedep_auth <> space.",
    "* ISELLIST in agreement with authority?",
    "            IF without_subset NE space.",
    "* ignore subsets",
    "              DELETE isellist WHERE ddic EQ 'S'.",
    "              DESCRIBE TABLE isellist.",
    "              IF sy-tfill GT 0.",
    "                CLEAR isellist-and_or.",
    "                MODIFY isellist INDEX sy-tfill TRANSPORTING and_or.",
    "              ENDIF.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "            CALL METHOD org_crit_inst->check_oc_auth_vim_sellist",
    "              EXPORTING",
    "                sellist = isellist[]",
    "                action  = '03'",
    "              EXCEPTIONS",
    "                no_auth = 1.",
    "            IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "              MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'E' NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "               WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "               RAISING no_auth_for_sel.",
    "            ENDIF.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            CLEAR org_crit_inst.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        WHEN 5.",
    "          MESSAGE i028 WITH view_name RAISING no_viewmaint_tool.",
    "        WHEN 9.",
    "          MESSAGE ID 'TB' TYPE 'I' NUMBER 109       \"no cli-indep auth",
    "                  RAISING no_authority.",
    "        WHEN 8.",
    "          MESSAGE i053 RAISING no_authority.",
    "        WHEN 10.",
    "          IF check_linedep_auth <> space.",
    "            MESSAGE e755 RAISING no_authority",
    "             WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4.",
    "*   Sie haben keine zeilenbezogene Anzeigeberechtigung für diese Tabelle",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "      ENDCASE.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF without_subset NE space.          \"ignore selections",
    "    header-subsetflag = space.",
    "    MODIFY header INDEX 1 TRANSPORTING subsetflag.",
    "    DELETE isellist WHERE ddic EQ 'S'.",
    "    DESCRIBE TABLE isellist.",
    "    IF sy-tfill GT 0.",
    "      CLEAR isellist-and_or.",
    "      MODIFY isellist INDEX sy-tfill TRANSPORTING and_or.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF without_exits NE space.           \"ignore exits",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_NAMETAB_GET'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "        tabname   = 'VIMDESC'",
    "      TABLES",
    "        x031l_tab = ix031l.",
    "    LOOP AT ix031l WHERE fieldname CP 'FRM*'.",
    "      ASSIGN COMPONENT ix031l-fieldname OF STRUCTURE header TO <field>.",
    "      CLEAR <field>.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "    MODIFY header INDEX 1.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* Tabellennamen bestimmen",
    "  IF header-bastab EQ space.           \"view",
    "    CLEAR: tot_name, ext_name.",
    "    CONCATENATE: header-maintview tot_suffix INTO tot_name,",
    "                 header-maintview ext_suffix INTO ext_name.",
    "  ELSE.                                \"table",
    "    READ TABLE header INDEX 1.",
    "    IF header-bastab EQ space OR header-texttbexst EQ space.",
    "    table_length = header-after_tabc / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "      x_table_length = table_length + 2.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      table_length = ( header-after_tabc + header-aft_txttbc )",
    "       / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "      x_table_length = table_length + 3.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    IF x_table_length LE ultra_short_tab.",
    "      tot_name = 'TOTAL_US[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_US[]'.",
    "    ELSEIF x_table_length LE very_short_tab.",
    "      tot_name = 'TOTAL_VS[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_VS[]'.",
    "    ELSEIF x_table_length LE short_tab.",
    "      tot_name = 'TOTAL_S[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_S[]'.",
    "    ELSEIF x_table_length LE middle_tab.",
    "      tot_name = 'TOTAL_M[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_M[]'.",
    "    ELSEIF x_table_length LE long_tab.",
    "      tot_name = 'TOTAL_L[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_L[]'.",
    "    ELSEIF x_table_length LE very_long_tab.",
    "      tot_name = 'TOTAL_VL[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_VL[]'.",
    "    ELSEIF x_table_length LE ultra_long_tab.",
    "      tot_name = 'TOTAL_UL[]'. ext_name = 'EXTRACT_UL[]'.",
    "    ELSEIF x_header-bastab NE space.   \"table",
    "      MESSAGE i516(sv) WITH view_name RAISING no_viewmaint_tool.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "* einlesen in die lokalen Tabs der Fgroup.",
    "  PERFORM vim_set_oc IN PROGRAM (header-fpoolname)",
    "   USING org_crit_inst.",
    "* TRANSLATE data_cont_type_x USING ' XX '.\"HCG No more need in x_call_vm",
    "****** Divide too long sellist into pieces of size maxsellines *****\"HCG",
    "  DESCRIBE TABLE dba_sellist LINES selnumber.",
    "*  IF selnumber > maxsellines.  \"fragmentation of too large sellists",
    "  CLEAR selpieces.",
    "  CLEAR selindex.",
    "  DESCRIBE TABLE data.",
    "  viewlen = sy-tleng + 2.        \"HCG If action and mark are not in data",
    "  IF data_cont_type_x = 'X'.  \"If hex in unicode only half length char",
    "    viewlen = viewlen / cl_abap_char_utilities=>charsize.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF viewlen <= 64.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot64 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot64 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ELSEIF viewlen <= 128.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot128 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot128 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ELSEIF viewlen <= 256.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot256 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot256 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ELSEIF viewlen <= 512.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot512 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot512 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ELSEIF viewlen <= 1024.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot1024 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot1024 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ELSEIF viewlen <= 2048.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot2048 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot2048 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ELSEIF viewlen <= 4096.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot4096 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot4096 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    ASSIGN wa_tot8192 TO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "    ASSIGN it_tot8192 TO <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  CLEAR <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "  REFRESH <it_tmp_data>.",
    "  ASSIGN data TO <data_wax> TYPE x.",
    "  IF selnumber = 0.",
    "    PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (header-fpoolname)",
    "*                     USING data_cont_type_x  \"HCG always char container",
    "                    USING space",
    "                          space",
    "                          corr_number",
    "                          'READ'",
    "                          'S'",
    "                          view_name",
    "                          tot_name",
    "                          ext_name",
    "                          rfc_destination",
    "                          space",
    "                          upd_requ",
    "                          icorrkeytab",
    "                          short_sellist[]",
    "                          short_sellist[]",
    "                          iexfun",
    "                          iex",
    "                          <it_tmp_data>[]",
    "                          header[]",
    "                          namtab[]",
    "                          dummytc",
    "                          sy-tabix",
    "                          results",
    "                          import_results[]",
    "                          space",
    "                          complex_selconds_used.",
    "    LOOP AT <it_tmp_data> INTO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "      IF data_cont_type_x = 'X'.                 \"Hex data container",
    "        ASSIGN <wa_it_tmp_data> TO <wax_it_tmp_data> TYPE x.",
    "        <data_wax> = <wax_it_tmp_data>.",
    "        APPEND data.",
    "      ELSE.                                     \"Char data container",
    "        APPEND <wa_it_tmp_data> TO data.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDLOOP.",
    "  ELSE.                      \"HCG fragmentation of too large sellists",
    "    WHILE selindex < selnumber.",
    "      selpieces = selpieces + maxsellines.",
    "      REFRESH short_sellist.",
    "      CLEAR selcut.",
    "      WHILE selcut EQ 0 AND selindex < selnumber.",
    "        selindex = selindex + 1.",
    "        READ TABLE dba_sellist INTO short_sel INDEX selindex.",
    "        APPEND short_sel TO short_sellist.",
    "        IF selindex > selpieces AND short_sel-and_or NE 'AND'.",
    "          selcut = 1.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDWHILE.",
    "      CLEAR short_sel-and_or.      \"last line without logic operation",
    "      MODIFY short_sellist FROM short_sel INDEX selindex.",
    "      PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (header-fpoolname)",
    "*                     USING data_cont_type_x  \"HCG always char container",
    "                      USING space",
    "                            space",
    "                            corr_number",
    "                            'READ'",
    "                            'S'",
    "                            view_name",
    "                            tot_name",
    "                            ext_name",
    "                            rfc_destination",
    "                            space",
    "                            upd_requ",
    "                            icorrkeytab",
    "                            short_sellist[]",
    "                            short_sellist[]",
    "                            iexfun",
    "                            iex",
    "                            <it_tmp_data>[]",
    "                            header[]",
    "                            namtab[]",
    "                            dummytc",
    "                            sy-tabix",
    "                            results",
    "                            import_results[]",
    "                            space",
    "                            complex_selconds_used.",
    "      LOOP AT <it_tmp_data> INTO <wa_it_tmp_data>.",
    "        IF data_cont_type_x = 'X'.                 \"Hex data container",
    "          ASSIGN <wa_it_tmp_data> TO <wax_it_tmp_data> TYPE x.",
    "          <data_wax> = <wax_it_tmp_data>.",
    "          APPEND data.",
    "        ELSE.                                     \"Char data container",
    "          APPEND <wa_it_tmp_data> TO data.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "    ENDWHILE.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "*  ELSE. \"Not submit datacontainer DATA[] itself, because it may be HEX",
    "*    PERFORM x_call_viewmaintenance IN PROGRAM (header-fpoolname)",
    "*                   USING data_cont_type_x",
    "*                         space",
    "*                         corr_number",
    "*                         'READ'",
    "*                         'S'",
    "*                         view_name",
    "*                         tot_name",
    "*                         ext_name",
    "*                         rfc_destination",
    "*                         space",
    "*                         upd_requ",
    "*                         icorrkeytab",
    "*                         isellist[]",
    "*                         isellist[]",
    "*                         iexfun",
    "*                         iex",
    "*                         data[]",
    "*                         header[]",
    "*                         namtab[]",
    "*                         dummytc",
    "*                         sy-tabix",
    "*                         results",
    "*                         import_results[]",
    "*                         space",
    "*                         complex_selconds_used.",
    "*  ENDIF.",
    "*******************************************************************\"HCG",
    "  IF NOT org_crit_inst IS INITIAL AND check_linedep_auth <> space.",
    "    CHECK NOT org_crit_inst->oc_selcrit_read_tab[] IS INITIAL.",
    "    MESSAGE i766(sv) RAISING data_access_restricted.",
    "*   Eingeschränkte Anzeige von Datensätzen.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
  "fingerprint": "439482eba8c222f8f29ddd3e91f92f6196115fbc735d73206e13cbba7fd4cf26",
  "interfaceFingerprint": "7c982e819b9841b5fcf26d42e78ca4a20247c4a8dc29e6fe055761562670508b",
  "sourceFingerprint": "b918ba8d8a364ed018f9a12a2d98d15dbe8272c5a478c0fc882b62d9de929851"
}

schema.name: read_function_module_interface
schema.description: Read one active function module interface and source through the SAP repository helper. Read-only and allowed for customer or standard function modules. Preserves raw updateTaskMode; updateTask is true for any noninitial update mode, including numeric SAP modes, not only X. Mode validity/meaning is not inferred. Returns a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint; includeExecutionSupport additionally resolves scalar, flat-structure, and table parameter shapes through DDIC.

{
  "connectionId": "w200",
  "functionName": "VIEW_ENQUEUE",
  "functionGroup": "SVIX",
  "shortText": "Lock/unlock view structure data",
  "remoteMode": "",
  "updateTask": false,
  "updateTaskMode": "",
  "globalInterface": true,
  "remoteEnabled": false,
  "importParameters": [
    {
      "name": "ACTION",
      "typeName": "",
      "optional": true,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Action: E --> lock, D --> unlock"
    },
    {
      "name": "ENQUEUE_MODE",

      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Lock mode: S --> shared, E --> exclusive"

    {
      "name": "VIEW_NAME",
      "typeName": "OCUS-TABLE",
      "optional": false,
      "passByValue": true,
      "description": "Name of the view to be processed"
    },
    {
      "name": "ENQUEUE_RANGE",
      "typeName": "",

    "FUNCTION view_enqueue.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Globale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"       IMPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(ACTION) DEFAULT 'E'",
    "*\"             VALUE(ENQUEUE_MODE) DEFAULT 'S'",
    "*\"             VALUE(VIEW_NAME) LIKE  OCUS-TABLE",
    "*\"             VALUE(ENQUEUE_RANGE) DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"       TABLES",
    "*\"              SELLIST STRUCTURE  VIMSELLIST OPTIONAL",
    "*\"       EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"              CLIENT_REFERENCE",
    "*\"              FOREIGN_LOCK",
    "*\"              INVALID_ACTION",
    "*\"              INVALID_ENQUEUE_MODE",
    "*\"              SYSTEM_FAILURE",
    "*\"              TABLE_NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: tabkey   LIKE rstable-varkey,",
    "        exclusive TYPE c VALUE 'E',",
    "        shared    TYPE c VALUE 'S',",
    "        enqueue   TYPE c VALUE 'E',",
    "        dequeue   TYPE c VALUE 'D',",
    "        n TYPE c VALUE 'N',",
    "        index LIKE sy-tabix, rc LIKE sy-subrc, rollback_action,",
    "*     GEN_ENQUEUE_PATTERN(2) TYPE C VALUE ' @'.",
    "        BEGIN OF tabkeys_safe OCCURS 10,",
    "          tabname LIKE rstable-tabname,",
    "          tabkey LIKE rstable-varkey,",
    "        END OF tabkeys_safe,",
    "        tab_name LIKE ocus-table.",
    "  DATA: viewfields_local TYPE ddfields.",
    "",
    "  IF action NE enqueue AND action NE dequeue.",
    "    RAISE invalid_action.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF enqueue_mode NE exclusive AND enqueue_mode NE shared.",
    "    RAISE invalid_enqueue_mode.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF last_view NE view_name.",
    "* get nametab-info",
    "    PERFORM prepare USING view_name.",
    "    last_view = view_name.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  REFRESH viewfields_local.",
    "  APPEND LINES OF viewfields TO viewfields_local.",
    "  IF last_enq_mode EQ space AND tvdir-bastab EQ space",
    "                            AND viewvari_of_tab = space.       \"Subviews",
    "    MOVE shared TO last_enq_mode.",
    "    IF last_dd26v_view NE view_name.",
    "      PERFORM get_dd26v USING view_name.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF enqueue_mode EQ exclusive AND last_enq_mode NE exclusive",
    "                               AND tvdir-bastab  EQ space",
    "                               AND viewvari_of_tab = space.    \"Subviews",
    "    MOVE enqueue_mode TO last_enq_mode.",
    "    IF last_enqtab_view NE view_name.",
    "      PERFORM fill_enqtab USING view_name.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF last_keyfields_view NE view_name.",
    "* fill keyfield-list",
    "    IF tvdir-bastab <> space AND text_tab_exists <> space.",
    "* add text key if necessary",
    "      READ TABLE viewfields_local WITH KEY tabname = text_table_name",
    "       TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        APPEND LINES OF textfields TO viewfields_local.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "    PERFORM fill_keyfields USING view_name",
    "                                 viewfields_local.",
    "    IF enqueue_mode EQ exclusive AND tvdir-bastab EQ space",
    "                                 AND viewvari_of_tab = space.  \"Subviews",
    "      CLEAR last_dd26v_view.",
    "      FREE: dd26v_tab, dd26v,",
    "            dd02l.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF action EQ enqueue.",
    "    rollback_action = dequeue.",
    "  ELSE.",
    "    rollback_action = enqueue.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF tvdir-bastab NE space OR             \"force bastab",
    "     viewvari_of_tab <> space.                                 \"Subviews",
    "    IF viewvari_of_tab <> space.                            \"Subviews ..",
    "      tab_name = mview_roottab.",
    "    ELSE.",
    "      tab_name = view_name.",
    "    ENDIF.                                                  \".. Subviews",
    "    PERFORM fill_tabkey USING tab_name tabkey.",
    "    tabkeys_safe-tabname = tab_name. tabkeys_safe-tabkey = tabkey.",
    "    APPEND tabkeys_safe.",
    "    PERFORM enqueue_tab USING tab_name tabkey",
    "                              enqueue_mode action.",
    "    IF sy-subrc EQ 0.",
    "      IF text_tab_exists NE space.",
    "* if entity table is client dependent, text tab must be cl. dep. too",
    "* --> use same TABKEY",
    "        PERFORM fill_tabkey USING text_table_name tabkey.",

    "                                  enqueue_mode action.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0.",

    "    ENDIF.",

    "    IF enqueue_mode EQ exclusive.",
    "      LOOP AT enqueue_table WHERE enqmode NE n.",

    "*         MOVE SY-MANDT TO TABKEY.",

    "        PERFORM fill_tabkey USING enqueue_table-tabname tabkey.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabname = enqueue_table-tabname.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabkey = tabkey.",
    "        APPEND tabkeys_safe.",
    "        PERFORM enqueue_tab USING enqueue_table-tabname tabkey",
    "                                  enqueue_table-enqmode action.",
    "        IF sy-subrc NE 0.",
    "* data could'nt be locked -> dequeue already locked data",
    "          MOVE sy-subrc TO rc.",
    "          LOOP AT enqueue_table TO index WHERE enqmode NE n.",
    "*           IF ENQUEUE_TABLE-CLIDEP NE SPACE.",
    "*             MOVE SY-MANDT TO TABKEY.",
    "*           ELSE.",
    "*             CLEAR TABKEY.",
    "*           ENDIF.",
    "*           TRANSLATE TABKEY USING GEN_ENQUEUE_PATTERN.",
    "            READ TABLE tabkeys_safe WITH KEY",
    "                                       tabname = enqueue_table-tabname.",
    "*           PERFORM ENQUEUE_TAB USING ENQUEUE_TABLE-TABNAME TABKEY",

    "                                      tabkeys_safe-tabkey",
    "                                  enqueue_table-enqmode rollback_action.",
    "          ENDLOOP.",
    "          EXIT.",

    "        PERFORM fill_tabkey USING dd02l_tab-tabname tabkey.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabname = dd02l_tab-tabname.",
    "        tabkeys_safe-tabkey = tabkey.",
    "        APPEND tabkeys_safe.",

*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
***INCLUDE LCTS_WBO_API_IMPLF03 .
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  read_req_header
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Read the header of a request or task from this system
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_req_header
  USING    pv_req_id TYPE trkorr
  CHANGING ps_request TYPE trwbo_request_header
           pv_result TYPE cts_result
           pt_messages TYPE cts_messages.

  DATA: ls_message TYPE cts_message.

  CLEAR: ps_request.

  IF pv_req_id(4) <> gv_trkorr_lead.
* illegal request id
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
      EXPORTING
        msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
        msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
        msgno   = '105'
        msgv1   = pv_req_id
      IMPORTING
        message = ls_message.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  ps_request-trkorr = pv_req_id.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_READ_REQUEST_HEADER'
    EXPORTING
      iv_read_e070  = 'X'
      iv_read_e07t  = 'X'
      iv_read_e070c = 'X'
    CHANGING
      cs_request    = ps_request
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS        = 1.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
* request does not exist
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    current_error_message_into ls_message.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " read_req_header

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  read_request_or_task
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Read a request or task from this system
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_request_or_task
  USING    pv_req_id TYPE trkorr
  CHANGING ps_request TYPE trwbo_request_header
           ps_task TYPE trwbo_request_header
           pv_is_task TYPE trboolean
           pv_result TYPE cts_result
           pt_messages TYPE cts_messages.

  DATA: ls_message TYPE cts_message,
        ls_req_header TYPE trwbo_request_header,
        lv_result TYPE cts_result.

  CLEAR: ps_request, ps_task, pv_is_task.

  lv_result = sctsa_result_ok.
  PERFORM read_req_header
    USING
      pv_req_id
    CHANGING
      ls_req_header
      lv_result
      pt_messages.
  IF lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

  IF ls_req_header-trfunction CA sctsc_types_projects.
* change request
    ps_request = ls_req_header.
    RETURN.
  ELSEIF ls_req_header-trfunction CA sctsc_types_tasks.
* task
    ps_task = ls_req_header.
    pv_is_task = 'X'.
    PERFORM read_req_header
      USING
        ps_task-strkorr
      CHANGING
        ls_req_header
        lv_result
        pt_messages.
    IF ( lv_result = sctsa_result_nok ) OR
       ( ls_req_header-trfunction NA sctsc_types_projects ).
      pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
        EXPORTING
          msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
          msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
          msgno   = '108'
          msgv1   = ps_task-strkorr
          msgv2   = ps_task-trkorr
        IMPORTING
          message = ls_message.
      APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    ps_request = ls_req_header.
    RETURN.
  ELSE.
* Neither change request nor task
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
      EXPORTING
        msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
        msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
        msgno   = '101'
        msgv1   = pv_req_id
      IMPORTING
        message = ls_message.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " read_request_or_task

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_for_release
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Check, whether a request or task can be released
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_for_release
  USING    ps_request TYPE trwbo_request_header
           pv_is_task TYPE trboolean
  CHANGING pv_result TYPE cts_result
           pt_messages TYPE cts_messages.

  DATA: ls_message TYPE cts_message,
        lv_result TYPE cts_result.

  lv_result = sctsa_result_ok.

* Authorization checks
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
    EXPORTING
      iv_trfunction = ps_request-trfunction
      iv_activity   = 'RELE'
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS        = 1.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    current_error_message_into ls_message.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF ps_request-as4user <> sy-uname.                        "#EC *
    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
      EXPORTING
        iv_trfunction = ps_request-trfunction
        iv_activity   = 'RLFN'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS        = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
      current_error_message_into ls_message.
      APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.

  IF lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    IF pv_is_task = 'X'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
        EXPORTING
          msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
          msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
          msgno   = '103'
          msgv1   = ps_request-strkorr
          msgv2   = ps_request-trkorr
        IMPORTING
          message = ls_message.
    ELSE.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
        EXPORTING
          msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
          msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
          msgno   = '102'
          msgv1   = ps_request-trkorr
        IMPORTING
          message = ls_message.
    ENDIF.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " check_for_release

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_tasks_for_release
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Check, whether unreleased tasks exist for a request, and
*       whether these can be released
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_tasks_for_release
  USING    pv_req_id TYPE trkorr
  CHANGING pt_tasks_for_release TYPE trwbo_t_e070
           pv_result TYPE cts_result
           pt_messages TYPE cts_messages.

  DATA: lp_task TYPE REF TO trwbo_s_e070,
        lt_unreleased_tasks TYPE trwbo_t_e070,
        ls_message TYPE cts_message,
        lv_result TYPE cts_result,
        lv_result2 TYPE cts_result,
        lt_e071 TYPE trwbo_t_e071.

  CLEAR pt_tasks_for_release.
  lv_result = sctsa_result_ok.

  SELECT * FROM e070 INTO TABLE lt_unreleased_tasks
    WHERE strkorr = pv_req_id
    AND   trstatus <> sctsc_state_released
    AND   trstatus <>  sctsc_state_notconfirmed.
* 1st loop: Check consistent task types
  LOOP AT lt_unreleased_tasks REFERENCE INTO lp_task.
    IF lp_task->trfunction NA sctsc_types_tasks.
      lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
        EXPORTING
          msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
          msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
          msgno   = '100'
          msgv1   = pv_req_id
          msgv2   = lp_task->trkorr
        IMPORTING
          message = ls_message.
      APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
      EXPORTING
        msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
        msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
        msgno   = '106'
        msgv1   = pv_req_id
      IMPORTING
        message = ls_message.
    APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.

* 2nd loop: determine tasks for release + authorization check
  LOOP AT lt_unreleased_tasks REFERENCE INTO lp_task.
    lv_result2 = sctsa_result_ok.
    SELECT * FROM e071 UP TO 1 ROWS
      INTO TABLE lt_e071
      WHERE trkorr = lp_task->trkorr.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.  " non-empty or empty task
*     Non-empty task: will be realeased during request release
      APPEND lp_task->* TO pt_tasks_for_release.
      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
        EXPORTING
          iv_trfunction = lp_task->trfunction
          iv_activity   = 'RELE'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS        = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_result2 = sctsa_result_nok.
        current_error_message_into ls_message.
        APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
      ENDIF.
      IF lp_task->as4user <> sy-uname.                      "#EC *
        CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
          EXPORTING
            iv_trfunction = lp_task->trfunction
            iv_activity   = 'RLFN'
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS        = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_result2 = sctsa_result_nok.
          current_error_message_into ls_message.
          APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_result2 = sctsa_result_nok.
        lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
        CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
          EXPORTING
            msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
            msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
            msgno   = '103'
            msgv1   = pv_req_id
            msgv2   = lp_task->trkorr
          IMPORTING
            message = ls_message.
        APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
      ENDIF.
    ELSE.  " non-empty or empty task
*     Empty task: will be deleted during request release
      CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
        EXPORTING
          iv_trfunction = lp_task->trfunction
          iv_activity   = 'DELE'
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS        = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        lv_result2 = sctsa_result_nok.
        current_error_message_into ls_message.
        APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
      ENDIF.
      IF lp_task->as4user <> sy-uname.                      "#EC *
        CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_TRFUNCTION'
          EXPORTING
            iv_trfunction = lp_task->trfunction
            iv_activity   = 'CHUS'
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS        = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          lv_result2 = sctsa_result_nok.
          current_error_message_into ls_message.
          APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_result2 = sctsa_result_nok.
        lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
        CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
          EXPORTING
            msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'
            msgty   = sctsa_result_nok
            msgno   = '104'
            msgv1   = pv_req_id
            msgv2   = lp_task->trkorr
          IMPORTING
            message = ls_message.
        APPEND ls_message TO pt_messages.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.  " non-empty or empty task
  ENDLOOP.
  IF lv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
      EXPORTING
        msgid   = 'CTS_WBO_API'

        msgno   = '106'

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&  Include           LCTS_WBO_API_IMPLF02

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  transform_requests
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Transform tables trwbo_request_headers, trwbo_t_e070a into
*       nested table cts_requests
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM transform_requests
  USING    pt_headers TYPE trwbo_request_headers
           pt_e070a TYPE trwbo_t_e070a
  CHANGING pt_requests TYPE cts_requests.

  DATA: lp_header TYPE REF TO trwbo_request_header,
        lp_e070a TYPE REF TO trwbo_s_e070a,
        ls_request TYPE cts_request,
        lp_request TYPE REF TO cts_request,
        ls_task_header TYPE cts_task_header,
        ls_attr TYPE cts_req_attr.

  CLEAR pt_requests.
* 1) transform request headers
  LOOP AT pt_headers REFERENCE INTO lp_header.
    IF lp_header->trfunction CA sctsc_types_projects.
      CLEAR ls_request.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING lp_header->* TO ls_request-req_header.
      APPEND ls_request TO pt_requests.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  SORT pt_requests BY req_header-trkorr.

* 2) transform task headers
  LOOP AT pt_headers REFERENCE INTO lp_header.
    IF lp_header->trfunction CA sctsc_types_tasks.
      READ TABLE pt_requests
        WITH KEY req_header-trkorr = lp_header->strkorr
        BINARY SEARCH
        REFERENCE INTO lp_request.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        CLEAR ls_task_header.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING lp_header->* TO ls_task_header.
        APPEND ls_task_header TO lp_request->task_headers.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

* 3) transform request attributes
  LOOP AT pt_e070a REFERENCE INTO lp_e070a.
    READ TABLE pt_requests
      WITH KEY req_header-trkorr = lp_e070a->trkorr
      BINARY SEARCH
      REFERENCE INTO lp_request.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      CLEAR ls_attr.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING lp_e070a->* TO ls_attr.
      APPEND ls_attr TO lp_request->req_attrs.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " transform_requests

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Perform global intializations of function group and
*       check authorization for API usage
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM initialization_with_check
  CHANGING pv_result TYPE cts_result
           pt_messages TYPE cts_messages.

  DATA: ls_message TYPE cts_message.

  PERFORM initialization.
  pv_result = sctsa_result_ok.
  CLEAR pt_messages.

* Check minimal authorizations for API usage.
* In case of missing authorization do not return any detailed information
* accordingly to security guidelines.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_AUTHORITY_CHECK_DISPLAY'
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS = 1.
  IF sy-subrc >< 0.
    pv_result = sctsa_result_nok.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Initialize objcat_entries from objcat_keys
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM init_objcat_entries
  USING    pt_keys TYPE cts_objcat_keys
  CHANGING pt_entries TYPE cts_objcat_entries.

  DATA: lp_key TYPE REF TO cts_objcat_key,
        ls_entry TYPE cts_objcat_entry.

  CLEAR pt_entries.

  LOOP AT pt_keys REFERENCE INTO lp_key.
    ls_entry-objcat_key = lp_key->*.
    APPEND ls_entry TO pt_entries.
  ENDLOOP.

  SORT pt_entries BY objcat_key-object objcat_key-obj_name.
  DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM pt_entries
    COMPARING objcat_key-object objcat_key-obj_name.

ENDFORM.                    " init_objcat_entries

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  check_objcat_entries
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Check syntactical correctness of objcat_entries
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM check_objcat_entries
  CHANGING pt_entries TYPE cts_objcat_entries.

  DATA: lp_entry TYPE REF TO cts_objcat_entry,
        ls_e071 TYPE trwbo_s_e071,
        lv_result TYPE trparflag.

  LOOP AT pt_entries REFERENCE INTO lp_entry.
    CLEAR ls_e071.
    ls_e071-pgmid = sctsa_r3tr.
    ls_e071-object = lp_entry->objcat_key-object.
    ls_e071-obj_name = lp_entry->objcat_key-obj_name.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TR_CHECK_TYPE'
      EXPORTING
        wi_e071   = ls_e071
      IMPORTING
        pe_result = lv_result.
    IF lv_result CA sctsa_must_tadir.
      lp_entry->is_supported = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " check_objcat_entries

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  read_objcat_entries
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Read entries from local object catalog
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_objcat_entries
  CHANGING pt_entries TYPE cts_objcat_entries.

  DATA: lp_entry TYPE REF TO cts_objcat_entry,
        ls_tadir TYPE tadir.

* Since API is intended for operations on small numbers of objects,
* do single selections to benefit from the table buffer.
  LOOP AT pt_entries REFERENCE INTO lp_entry.
    IF lp_entry->is_supported = 'X'.
      CLEAR ls_tadir.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM tadir INTO ls_tadir
        WHERE pgmid = sctsa_r3tr
        AND   object = lp_entry->objcat_key-object
        AND   obj_name = lp_entry->objcat_key-obj_name.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lp_entry->exists = 'X'.
        MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_tadir TO lp_entry->objcat_attr.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

ENDFORM.                    " read_objcat_entries

*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*&      Form  read_global_objcat_entries
*&---------------------------------------------------------------------*
*       Read entries from global object catalog
*----------------------------------------------------------------------*
FORM read_global_objcat_entries
  CHANGING pt_entries TYPE cts_objcat_entries.

  DATA: lp_entry TYPE REF TO cts_objcat_entry,
        ls_gtadir TYPE gtadir,
        lp_gtadir TYPE REF TO gtadir,
        lt_gtadir_in TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gtadir,
        lt_gtadir_out TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF gtadir.

  LOOP AT pt_entries REFERENCE INTO lp_entry.
    IF ( lp_entry->is_supported = 'X' ) AND
       ( lp_entry->exists = space ).
      CLEAR ls_gtadir.
      ls_gtadir-pgmid = sctsa_r3tr.
      ls_gtadir-object = lp_entry->objcat_key-object.
      ls_gtadir-obj_name = lp_entry->objcat_key-obj_name.
      APPEND ls_gtadir TO lt_gtadir_in.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.

* Query must be simple and robust. Treat errors like not found entries.
  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_GTADIR_LIST_QUERY'
    TABLES
      e_table = lt_gtadir_out
      i_table = lt_gtadir_in
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS  = 0.

  LOOP AT lt_gtadir_out REFERENCE INTO lp_gtadir.
    READ TABLE pt_entries
      WITH KEY objcat_key-object = lp_gtadir->object
               objcat_key-obj_name = lp_gtadir->obj_name    "#EC *
      BINARY SEARCH
      REFERENCE INTO lp_entry.
    IF ( sy-subrc = 0 ) AND

      lp_entry->exists_globally = 'X'.
      MOVE-CORRESPONDING lp_gtadir->* TO lp_entry->objcat_attr.

FORM call_objects_check_and_insert
  USING

    EXPORTING
      it_recording_entries = pt_recording_entries
    IMPORTING
      et_obj_entries       = lt_obj_entries.

* Invoke TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT
  CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_OBJECTS_CHECK_AND_INSERT'
    EXPORTING
      iv_order                     = space
      iv_with_dialog               = lv_with_dialog
      iv_send_message              = space
      iv_no_show_option            = space
      iv_no_standard_editor        = space
      iv_externalps                = space
      iv_externalid                = space

      iv_insert_into_sbcsets       = space
      iv_old_call                  = space
      is_api_call                  = ps_api_call
      it_obj_entries               = lt_obj_entries
    IMPORTING
      es_result                    = ls_result
      et_objprops                  = lt_objprops
    CHANGING
      ct_ko200                     = pt_ko200
      ct_e071k                     = pt_e071k
    EXCEPTIONS
      OTHERS                       = 1.

  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
* Should not happen.
    lv_msgid   = sy-msgid.
    lv_msgno   = sy-msgno.
    lv_msgv1   = sy-msgv1.
    lv_msgv2   = sy-msgv2.
    lv_msgv3   = sy-msgv3.
    lv_msgv4   = sy-msgv4.
* Reference parameters may contain something. Let's get, what we have.
    ps_check_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
    pt_messages = ls_result-messages.
    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'
      EXPORTING

    CALL FUNCTION 'TRINT_CREATE_CTS_MESSAGE'

        msgv1   = lv_msgv1

  ENDIF.

* Convert export parameters
  IF ps_check_result-result = sctsa_result_ok.
    ps_check_result-recording = ls_result-recording.
    ps_check_result-existing_req_only = ls_result-existing_req_only.

* Convert recording request and task
    CLEAR: lt_headers, lt_e070a.
    IF ls_result-request-h-trkorr <> space.
      APPEND ls_result-request-h TO lt_headers.
      IF ls_result-task-trkorr <> space.
        APPEND ls_result-task TO lt_headers.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_result-repair-trkorr <> space.
        APPEND ls_result-repair TO lt_headers.
      ENDIF.
      PERFORM transform_requests
        USING
          lt_headers
          ls_result-request-attributes
        CHANGING
          lt_requests.
* There should be exactly one entry in lt_requests
      READ TABLE lt_requests INDEX 1 REFERENCE INTO lr_request.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ps_recording_request = lr_request->*.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

* Convert usable requests
    CLEAR: lt_headers, lt_e070a.
    LOOP AT ls_result-requests REFERENCE INTO lr_req.
      APPEND lr_req->h TO lt_headers.
      APPEND LINES OF lr_req->attributes TO lt_e070a.
    ENDLOOP.
    PERFORM transform_requests
      USING
        lt_headers
        lt_e070a
      CHANGING
        pt_usable_requests.
  ENDIF.

* Convert object locks (in case of check invocation or insert invocation with errors)
  IF ps_api_call-is_check = 'X'
  OR ps_check_result-result = sctsa_result_nok.
    LOOP AT lt_objprops REFERENCE INTO lr_objprops.
      CLEAR: lt_headers, lt_e070a.
      LOOP AT lr_objprops->locks REFERENCE INTO lr_rtpair.
        IF lr_rtpair->request-h-trkorr <> space.
          APPEND lr_rtpair->request-h TO lt_headers.
          APPEND LINES OF lr_rtpair->request-attributes TO lt_e070a.
          IF lr_rtpair->task-trkorr <> space.
            APPEND lr_rtpair->task TO lt_headers.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
* Since we have one pair entry per TLOCK entry, requests (and even tasks)
* may be contained several times. Sort and remove duplicates.
      SORT lt_headers BY trkorr.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_headers COMPARING trkorr.
      SORT lt_e070a BY trkorr pos.
      DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_e070a COMPARING trkorr pos.
      PERFORM transform_requests
        USING
          lt_headers
          lt_e070a
        CHANGING
          lt_requests.
      CLEAR ls_object_lock.
      ls_object_lock-object_key = lr_objprops->key.
      LOOP AT lt_requests REFERENCE INTO lr_request.
        ls_object_lock-lock_holder = lr_request->*.
        APPEND ls_object_lock TO pt_object_locks.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.

ENDFORM.                    " call_objects_check_and_insert
